definition_en: to say or do the same thing more than once
core_image: 同一句话从嘴里第二次、第三次说出来，像回声绕回来
scene: 老师没听清答案，让学生再说一遍，学生于是重复了刚才那句话。The teacher asked him to repeat the sentence more slowly.
sceneCN: 这里 repeat 是「重说；重复」（第 1 个义项：把说过的话再说一次）；句意：老师让他把这句话再慢慢重复一遍。

senses.title: To say something again
senses.definition: to say or write something again, either once more or several times
senses.definitionCN: 把说过或写过的话再说一遍或说好几遍
senses.example: Could you repeat the last question?
senses.exampleCN: 你能把最后一个问题再说一遍吗？
senses.why: The core of the Latin verb is to seek again, so going back over the same words is the first sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词的核心意思是「再次寻求」，所以回到同一句话上就是第一个义项。

senses.title: To do something again
senses.definition: to do an action or performance again
senses.definitionCN: 把某个动作或表演再做一次
senses.example: The team repeated the experiment to check the result.
senses.exampleCN: 团队重做了实验来核对结果。
senses.why: Once repeating is about going over something again, it easily moves from words to actions.
senses.whyCN: 既然重复是「再走一遍」，它就很容易从言语扩展到动作。

senses.title: To happen again
senses.definition: to happen again in the same way
senses.definitionCN: 以相同的方式再次发生
senses.example: History often repeats itself in small ways.
senses.exampleCN: 历史常常以细微的方式重演。
senses.why: When an event returns in the same pattern, people describe it as repeating itself.
senses.whyCN: 当一件事以同样的模式再次出现，人们就说它「重演」。

intro.en: Repeat comes from Latin repetere, to seek again, formed from re-, again, and petere, to seek.
intro.cn: repeat 来自拉丁语 repetere（再次寻求），由 re-（再次）与 petere（寻求）构成。

items.en: Petere means to seek, head for, or attack, and it supplies the central stem.
items.cn: petere 意为寻求、前往或攻击，提供核心词干。

items.en: Repetere adds re-, again, and means to go back for something or say it over.
items.cn: repetere 加上 re-（再次），意为回去取某物或把话再说一遍。

items.en: The noun repetitio names the act of going over something again.
items.cn: 名词 repetitio 指把某事再过一遍的动作。

items.en: Old French repeter keeps both the spoken and the renewed-action senses.
items.cn: 古法语 repeter 保留了「重说」和「重做」两种意思。

items.en: Middle English repeat enters through French and is used for words, deeds, and events.
items.cn: 中古英语 repeat 经法语进入，用于言语、行为和事件。

items.en: Modern English adds the noun use for a repeated broadcast or performance.
items.cn: 现代英语又增加名词用法，指重播节目或重演。

note.en: Repeat is the plain verb of doing something again, and its family includes the nouns and adjectives built from the same Latin stem.
note.cn: repeat 是表示「再做一次」的朴素动词，其词族包括由同一拉丁词干构成的名词和形容词。

entries.definition: the act of repeating something
done or said many times in the same way
many times, again and again
to say something again for emphasis
to say something again in a clearer way
to repeat a sound or someone's words
to make an exact copy of something

normalIntro.en: Repeat can be heard as re- plus peat, and the second part sounds like beat, so the word feels like hitting the same note again.
normalIntro.cn: repeat 可以听成 re- 加 peat，后半截又像 beat，于是整个词像把同一个音再敲一遍。

normal.en: Re- means again, and the rest of the word is the thing being said: say it again.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，后面那部分是所说的内容：再说一次。

normal.en: Repeat after me is the classroom phrase that fixes the word in memory.
normal.cn: repeat after me 是课堂用语，最容易把这个词记牢。

normal.en: History repeats itself turns the word from speech to events.
normal.cn: history repeats itself 把这个词从言语转到事件。

normal.en: Compare repetition: the noun adds -ition and keeps the same stem.
normal.cn: 对比 repetition：名词加 -ition，词干不变。

normal.en: Repeat the mistake is a common phrase, so the word can carry a warning.
normal.cn: repeat the mistake 是常见搭配，所以这个词也能带警告意味。

abstract.en: Picture a parrot that says the same phrase at the same time every morning.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鹦鹉每天早晨同一时间说同一句话。

abstract.en: Imagine a song stuck in your head returning to the same line.
abstract.cn: 想象一首歌在脑中循环，总回到同一句。

abstract.en: Think of footprints walking back over their own path in the snow.
abstract.cn: 想象雪地上的脚印沿着原路又走了一遍。

examples.en: Please repeat your name for the record.
examples.cn: 请再说一遍你的名字，以便记录。

examples.en: The class repeated the drill until everyone could do it.
examples.cn: 全班反复练习这个动作，直到每个人都会做。

examples.en: The same argument was repeated at every meeting.
examples.cn: 同样的争论在每次会议上都重复出现。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞皮特」——瑞气重复得特别多；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ petere（寻求）→ repetere（再次寻求、重说）→ 古法语 repeter → 中古英语 repeat。

sensesIntro.en: One motion of going back over something produces three senses: the same words again, the same action again, and the same event returning.
sensesIntro.cn: 「把某事再走一遍」这一个动作生出三个义项：同样的话再说、同样的动作再做、同样的事件再次出现。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same sound or action returning to the starting point.
core.cn: 核心意象：同一个声音或动作回到起点，再走一遍。

branches.en: Saying the same words once more is the basic verbal sense.
branches.cn: 把同样的话再说一次，是最基本的言语义项。

branches.en: The repetition moves from speech to action and performance.
branches.cn: 重复从言语扩展到动作和表演。

branches.en: When events return in the same pattern, the word describes history repeating.
branches.cn: 当事件以同样模式返回，这个词就描述历史重演。

branches.en: Words and actions share the same return motion.
branches.cn: 言语和动作共享同一个「返回」动作。

branches.en: A repeated action and a recurring event both form a cycle.
branches.cn: 反复的动作与循环的事件都构成一个周期。

intro.en: Repeat is a Latin verb built from a prefix and a root, with its noun and adjective family formed by English endings.
intro.cn: repeat 是由前缀和词根构成的拉丁动词，其名词与形容词词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, and petere means to seek or go toward.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示再次，petere 表示寻求或前往。

items.example: Re- appears in repeat and return.
items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 repeat 和 return 中。

items.example: Petere is the root of repeat and petition.
items.exampleCN: petere 是 repeat 与 petition 的词根。
repetere 由 re- 与 petere 合成。

items.example: Repetitio is the Latin noun behind repetition.
items.exampleCN: repetitio 是 repetition 背后的拉丁名词。

items.example: Repeat carries the Latin verb into English.
items.exampleCN: repeat 把拉丁动词带入英语。

items.example: Repetition adds -ition to the Latin stem.
items.exampleCN: repetition 在拉丁词干后加 -ition。

items.example: Repetitive adds -ive to the same stem.
items.exampleCN: repetitive 在同一词干后加 -ive。

items.example: Repeatedly is built from repeated plus -ly.
items.exampleCN: repeatedly 由 repeated 加 -ly 构成。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ition 构成 repetition。

definition_en: to put something back in its place, or to take the place of something else
core_image: 旧零件被取下，新零件咔哒一声装进同一个位置
scene: 旧电池耗尽后，她把新电池放进遥控器，咔哒一声又能换台了。She replaced the dead batteries with fresh ones.
sceneCN: 这里 replace 是「替换；更换」（第 3 个义项：用新东西换掉旧东西）；句意：她把没电的电池换成了新电池。

senses.title: To put back in place
senses.definition: to put something back where it was before
senses.definitionCN: 把某物放回它原来所在的位置
senses.example: She replaced the book on the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 她把书放回书架上。
senses.why: The word is literally re- plus place, so the oldest and most concrete sense is putting something back into its place.
senses.whyCN: 这个词字面上就是 re- 加 place，所以最古老、最具体的义项是「放回原位」。

senses.title: To take the place of
senses.definition: to do the job or fill the position of someone or something else
senses.definitionCN: 承担某人或某物的职责，或占据其位置
senses.example: Email has largely replaced the fax.
senses.exampleCN: 电子邮件已在很大程度上取代了传真。
senses.why: If one thing goes back into the same slot, it can push out what was there, which gives the sense of taking over.
senses.whyCN: 如果一个东西回到同一个位置，就可能把原来在那里的东西挤出去，于是产生「接管」之意。

senses.title: To change one thing for another
senses.definition: to remove something and put a new or different thing in its place
senses.definitionCN: 取走某物，并在原位放上新的或不同的事物
senses.example: You should replace the filter every three months.
senses.exampleCN: 你应该每三个月更换一次滤芯。
senses.why: The same slot is filled again, but this time the emphasis falls on the swap between old and new.
senses.whyCN: 同一个位置再次被填满，但这次强调的是新旧之间的对换。

intro.en: Replace is an English formation from re- and place, where place comes through French from Latin platea, a broad street.
intro.cn: replace 是英语用 re- 与 place 构成的词，而 place 经由法语来自拉丁语 platea（宽阔的街道）。

items.en: Platea means a broad street or open square, and later a position or site.
items.cn: platea 指宽阔的街道或开阔的广场，后来也指位置或场地。

items.en: Old French place narrows the word to a position, spot, or room.
items.cn: 古法语 place 把词义收窄为位置、地点或空间。

items.en: Middle English place names a location as well as a rank or role.
items.cn: 中古英语 place 既指地点，也指位次或角色。

items.en: English speakers add re- to place to make replace, meaning put back.
items.cn: 英语使用者给 place 加 re- 构成 replace，意为「放回」。

items.en: The sense widens from putting back to filling a position left by another.
items.cn: 词义从「放回」扩展到「填补他人留下的位置」。

items.en: Modern English uses replace for both restoring and substituting.
items.cn: 现代英语中 replace 既可表示放回，也可表示替换。

note.en: Replace sits between putting back and swapping out, and its family covers the act, the ability, and the impossibility of substitution.
note.cn: replace 介于「放回」与「换掉」之间，其词族涵盖替换的动作、可能性与不可替代性。

entries.definition: the act of replacing, or the thing that replaces
able to be replaced
too special to be replaced
to use one thing instead of another
to replace something, especially by force or over time
entries.definitionCN: 取代，尤指逐步或强行取代

entries.definition: to force something out of its usual place
to put something back into its former state

normalIntro.en: Replace is transparent: re- means again, and place means position, so the word pictures something returning to a slot.
normalIntro.cn: replace 的构词很透明：re- 表示再次，place 表示位置，合起来就是「重新回到一个位置」。

normal.en: Re- plus place: put it back in place.
normal.cn: re- 加 place：把它放回原处。

normal.en: Replace with is the phrase for a swap: old out, new in.
normal.cn: replace with 是替换的固定搭配：旧的出去，新的进来。

normal.en: Be replaced by turns the sentence around and puts the newcomer first.
normal.cn: be replaced by 把句子倒过来，让新来者作主语。

normal.en: Replaceable and irreplaceable differ only by the negative prefix.
normal.cn: replaceable 与 irreplaceable 只差一个否定前缀。

normal.en: A replacement part is a part that goes into the same slot.
normal.cn: replacement part 就是装进同一个位置的零件。

abstract.en: Picture a battery sliding out and a fresh one clicking in.
abstract.cn: 想象旧电池滑出，新电池咔哒一声装进去。

abstract.en: Imagine a name plate being unscrewed from an office door.
abstract.cn: 想象办公室门上的名牌被拧下来换掉。

abstract.en: Think of a book returned to the exact gap it left on the shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象一本书被放回书架上原来那个空隙。

examples.en: Please replace the tools when you have finished.
examples.cn: 用完后请把工具放回原处。

examples.en: Robots have replaced many workers on the production line.
examples.cn: 机器人已经取代了生产线上的许多工人。

examples.en: The hospital replaced all the old beds last year.
examples.cn: 医院去年更换了所有旧病床。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（重新）+ place（位置）＝重新放回位置，进而表示替换；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: re-（重新、再次）+ place（位置，源自拉丁语 platea「宽街、场地」），16 世纪英语内部构成，本义「放回原处」，后引申为「取代、替换」。

sensesIntro.en: One slot is filled again: first the object simply goes back, then it takes over the slot, and finally the old and new are swapped.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个位置被再次填满：先只是把东西放回去，再是它占据这个位置，最后是新旧对换。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an empty slot filled again by something new or returning.
core.cn: 核心意象：空出的位置被重新填入，或被新物占据。

branches.en: Putting the same object back is the literal re- plus place sense.
branches.cn: 把同一个物件放回去，是 re- 加 place 的字面义。

branches.en: When the newcomer fills the slot, it takes the place of what was there.
branches.cn: 新来者占据位置时，就取代了原本在那里的东西。

branches.en: The slot stays, but the thing inside is deliberately swapped.
branches.cn: 位置不变，但里面的东西被有意换掉。

branches.en: Returning and taking over both depend on the same fixed position.
branches.cn: 放回与接管都依赖同一个固定位置。

branches.en: Substitution and replacement describe the same handover from different angles.
branches.cn: 取代与替换从不同角度描述同一次交接。

intro.en: Replace is an English prefix-and-word formation whose second element comes from Latin through French.
intro.cn: replace 是英语用前缀加单词构成的词，后一部分经法语来自拉丁语。

latinIntro.en: The Latin platea gives the idea of a broad place or position, which becomes English place.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 platea 提供「宽阔场地、位置」的意思，后来成为英语 place。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 replace 与 restore 开头。

items.example: Place is the base of replace.
items.exampleCN: place 是 replace 的基础词。

items.example: Platea is the distant source of place.
items.exampleCN: platea 是 place 的远源。
replace 由 re- 与 place 合成。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ment 构成 replacement。

items.meaning: the act or thing that replaces
items.exampleCN: replacement 在 replace 后加 -ment。
replaceable 在 replace 后加 -able。

items.example: The prefix ir- makes replaceable negative.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ir- 使 replaceable 变成否定。
词尾 -able 构成 replaceable。
词尾 -ible 出现在 irreplaceable 中。

definition_zh: 复制；重复（实验或研究）；重现（结果）；自我复制；折叠回折（书面古义）；答复（古义）；重复实验中的一次平行试验
definition_en: to make an exact copy of something, or to repeat an experiment or process so as to obtain the same result
core_image: 一枚半透明的模子扣在原件上，压出的纹路与原件分毫不差，连凹痕的深浅都一样
scene: 实验室换了另一批人，却仍照着原来的步骤把同一项研究从头做了一遍。A second team tried to replicate the study with fresh samples.
sceneCN: 这里指把同一项研究再做一遍，看能否得到一致的结果（第 2 个义项：重复实验）；句意为另一个团队用新的样本重复了这项研究。场景图取象：模子压出的纹路与原件一模一样。

pos.zh: 自我复制（细胞、遗传物质层面）
重复实验中的一次平行试验（统计学用语）

derivatives.zh: 复制；重复实验；自我复制（由动词加表示「行为、过程」的拉丁后缀构成，指动作本身或一次复现）
复制品；仿制品（由拉丁词干加表示「成品」的名词后缀构成，从「折回之物」转为「照原样做出的东西」）
可复制的；可重复的（加表示「能够被……」的形容词后缀，指结果别人也做得出来）
可重复性（在可重复的形容词后加表示「性质」的名词后缀，科学界用来衡量结果能否被他人复现）
复制性的；与复制有关的（加表示「属于、倾向于」的形容词后缀，多用于描述细胞或病毒的复制活动）
复制者；复制装置（加表示「施动者」的名词后缀，指执行复制的主体或仪器）
复制子（分子生物学用语，指能独立复制的一段遗传物质，由复制一词加表示「单位」的后缀构成）

senses.title: Make an exact copy
senses.definition: to produce an exact copy of a thing, so that the copy matches the original in every detail
senses.definitionCN: 精确地复制某物，使副本与原件的每一处细节都相同
senses.example: The workshop can replicate a carved panel that broke off a century ago.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工坊能复制一块一个世纪前断裂的雕花板。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to fold back, and folding a sheet back over its source traces the same line twice.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词本义为折回；把一张纸沿原样折回叠在源头上，等于把同一条线描了第二遍。

senses.title: Run the study again
senses.definition: to repeat an experiment or study in order to see whether the same result appears
senses.definitionCN: 把一项实验或研究再做一次，以检验能否得到相同的结果
senses.example: No other laboratory could replicate the finding.
senses.exampleCN: 没有其他实验室能重现这一发现。
senses.why: Repeating a procedure is going over it again, which the fold image captures: the same line, drawn a second time.
senses.whyCN: 重复一套程序就是把它再走一遍，折回的意象正好对应：同一条线，再描第二次。

senses.title: Copy itself
senses.definition: to make copies of itself, as genetic material or a cell does before division
senses.definitionCN: 自身制造副本，如遗传物质或细胞在分裂前所做的那样
senses.example: The virus replicates inside the host cell.
senses.exampleCN: 病毒在宿主细胞内自我复制。
senses.why: Molecular biology borrowed the word because a strand that copies itself repeats its own sequence exactly.
senses.whyCN: 分子生物学借用了这个词，因为一条链复制自身时，把自己的序列原样重复了一遍。

senses.title: Carry a result into a new setting
senses.titleCN: 把结果搬到新环境里重现
senses.definition: to reproduce a result, pattern or success in a different place or under different conditions
senses.definitionCN: 在不同的地点或条件下再现某一结果、模式或成功经验
senses.example: The school tried to replicate its reading programme in three rural districts.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校试着把它的阅读课程推广到三个乡村学区。
senses.why: If a pattern holds in a new place, the second case repeats the first like a fold laid over it.
senses.whyCN: 如果一个模式在新地方照样成立，第二个例子就像一层折过来盖住第一个。

senses.title: Copy data to another system
senses.titleCN: 把数据复制到另一套系统
senses.definition: to copy data continuously or on demand from one store to another so that both stay identical
senses.definitionCN: 把数据持续或按需从一个存储位置复制到另一处，使两边保持一致
senses.example: The database replicates every record to a backup server.
senses.exampleCN: 这个数据库把每条记录都复制到备份服务器上。
senses.why: Computing keeps the oldest sense: an exact duplicate kept somewhere else against loss.
senses.whyCN: 计算机领域保留了最古老的含义：在别处留一份一模一样的副本，以防丢失。

senses.title: Fold back, as a leaf
senses.definition: to fold back on itself, as a leaf edge, petal or membrane does
senses.definitionCN: 自身向后折转，如叶缘、花瓣或膜片所做的那样
senses.example: The petals replicate at the tip and form a small hood.
senses.exampleCN: 花瓣在尖端向后折，形成一个小小的兜状结构。
senses.why: This is the literal Latin sense, still used in botanical and anatomical description.
senses.whyCN: 这是拉丁语本义，至今仍用于植物学与解剖学的形态描述。

senses.title: Answer, in older usage
senses.definition: to reply or answer, a sense common in older English and in diplomacy
senses.definitionCN: 回答、答复；这是旧时英语与外交文书中的常见用法
senses.example: The envoy replicated that the terms were refused.
senses.exampleCN: 使节答复说这些条件已被拒绝。
senses.why: The same Latin verb also meant to reply, because answering turns the question back toward the asker.
senses.whyCN: 同一个拉丁动词也有答复之义，因为回答就是把问题朝提问者转回去。

senses.title: One repeated run
senses.definition: one of several repeated runs or samples in an experiment, treated as a unit for analysis
senses.definitionCN: 实验中若干次重复操作或样本之一，作为分析时的一个单位
senses.example: Each replicate was measured at a different temperature.
senses.exampleCN: 每一次平行试验都在不同的温度下测量。
senses.why: Statistics turned the verb into a noun for a single repeat among several, so the count could be discussed.
senses.whyCN: 统计学把这个动词变成名词，指若干重复中的一次，好把次数说清楚。

senses.title: Reproduce a work of art
senses.titleCN: 把一件作品照样做出来
senses.definition: to reproduce a painting, object or design as a faithful copy for study, display or replacement
senses.definitionCN: 把绘画、器物或设计照原样复制出来，用于研究、陈列或替换原件
senses.example: Students replicated the fresco on a smaller panel.
senses.exampleCN: 学生们在一块较小的板上复制了那幅壁画。
senses.why: Museums and craftsmen use the word for stand-in copies that carry the look of the original.
senses.whyCN: 博物馆与工匠用这个词指代用品，它承袭了原件的样子。

intro.en: Replicate goes back to Latin replicare, built from re- 'back' and plicare 'to fold'. The chain of form and meaning is clear, though the exact century in which each English sense appeared is less certain.
intro.cn: replicate 可追溯至拉丁语 replicare，由表示「向后」的前缀与表示「折叠」的词根构成。词形与词义的链条清楚，只是各个英语义项出现的确切年代较难确定。

items.en: Replicare meant to fold back, to turn a thing over, and from that to go over something again.
items.cn: replicare 意为折回、翻转某物，由此引申为把某事再过一遍。

items.en: The root plicare also built complicate, explicit, imply, duplicity and supple, all through the image of folding or plaiting.
items.cn: 词根 plicare 还构成 complicate、explicit、imply、duplicity 与 supple，全都经由折叠或编织的意象。

items.en: Because a reply turns a question back to the asker, replicare also took the sense of answering, which English kept as a rare older use.
items.cn: 回答是把问题朝提问者转回去，replicare 因此也有答复之义，英语保留了这一罕见的旧用法。

items.en: The word came into English through learned Latin in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries, first describing folded leaves and membranes.
items.cn: 这个词在十五、十六世纪经由学术拉丁语进入英语，最初用来描述折转的叶片与膜片。

items.en: The modern senses of repeating an experiment and of making a copy are nineteenth-century developments, pushed by laboratory practice and printing.
items.cn: 重复实验与制作副本这两个现代义项是十九世纪的发展，由实验室实践与印刷需求推动。

items.en: In the twenty-first century replication became a public word, as whole fields argued over which published results could be reproduced.
items.cn: 二十一世纪，replication 成了公共词汇，因为多个学科都在争论哪些已发表的结果能够被重现。

note.en: The first group shares the Latin folding root or looks close; the second group names the practical acts that stand beside replicate.
note.cn: 第一组或共享拉丁语折叠词根，或字形相近；第二组是实践中与「复制、重复」相邻的说法。

entries.definition: A copy of an object, especially one made to look exactly like the original.
entries.definitionCN: 器物的复制品，尤指外观与原件完全相同者。

entries.definition: The act or process of copying, or a single repeat of an experiment.
entries.definitionCN: 复制的行为或过程，也指实验的一次重复。

entries.definition: To make a second copy; built on the same folding root with the idea of two.
entries.definitionCN: 做出第二份；同用折叠词根，只是取「二」之意。

entries.definition: To make something harder by adding parts; literally to fold everything together.
entries.definitionCN: 因加入部分而变复杂；字面即把所有东西折在一起。

entries.definition: To involve someone in a matter, literally to fold a person into it.
entries.definitionCN: 使人牵连其中，字面即把人折进去。

entries.definition: To produce a copy or to bring a result back into existence, the broad everyday verb.
entries.definitionCN: 造出副本或使结果再次出现，是最宽泛的日常说法。

entries.definition: To make something identical, the plain word that needs no method behind it.
entries.definitionCN: 照原样做出相同之物，最朴素、不含方法意味的词。

entries.definition: To do or say again, without the suggestion of checking a result.
entries.definitionCN: 再做或再说一遍，不含检验结果的意思。

entries.definition: To establish that something is true, the purpose behind repeating a study.
entries.definitionCN: 确证某事为真，正是重复研究的用意。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin folding root, the real word family and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁语折叠词根、真实同族词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Re- means back and plicare means fold, so replicate is literally to fold a thing back onto itself.
normal.cn: 前缀意为向后，词根意为折叠，合起来就是把它折回自身。

normal.en: The folding root also built complicate and imply, so the family is one image with different directions.
normal.cn: 折叠词根还造出 complicate 与 imply，同族词是同一意象的不同走向。

normal.en: Botany still says a petal replicates, using the literal sense of folding back.
normal.cn: 植物学至今仍说花瓣向后折，用的就是折回的本义。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the science: replicate a study, replicate the results, fail to replicate.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出科研用途：重复一项研究、重现结果、未能重现。

normal.en: The noun replicate counts one repeated run, and the noun replication names the whole act.
normal.cn: 名词 replicate 指一次重复，名词 replication 指整个复制行为。

abstract.en: To replicate is to insist that the same thing can happen twice, which is the wager of every experiment.
abstract.cn: 复制就是坚持同一件事能够发生第二次，这正是每次实验押下的赌注。

abstract.en: The second copy is never quite the same object, only the same shape pressed again.
abstract.cn: 第二份从来不是同一个物件，只是同一形状又被压了一次。

abstract.en: A result that cannot be folded back onto itself stays a story rather than a finding.
abstract.cn: 无法折回自身重现的结果，只能算一个说法，算不得发现。

examples.en: Her team replicated the survey in two other provinces.
examples.cn: 她的团队在另外两个省重复了这项调查。

examples.en: A printed page can be replicated down to the grain of the paper.
examples.cn: 一页印刷品能复制到连纸纹都一致的程度。

examples.en: Cells replicate their DNA before they divide.
examples.cn: 细胞在分裂前先复制自己的遗传物质。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「瑞普利凯特」——把原件照原样再压一遍，压出来的就是副本：复制、重复

root: 拉丁语 replicare「折回、翻转」← re-「向后」＋ plicare「折叠」；同根词有 complicate、explicit、imply、duplicity、supple。古义含「答复」，今义「重复实验」「复制」为十九世纪以后的扩展，各义项确切年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses trace one fold: an exact copy, a repeated study, a cell copying itself, a result carried to a new place, data copied to a second store, a leaf folded back, an old reply, one repeated run, and a copy of a work of art.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿着同一次折叠展开：分毫不差的副本、重复的研究、细胞的自我复制、被搬到新环境的结果、复制到另一处的数据、向后折的叶片、旧时的答复、一次平行试验，以及艺术品的照样复制。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a mould pressed onto an original, leaving the same lines in a second material.
core.cn: 核心意象：一枚模子扣在原件上，在另一种材料里留下同样的纹路。

branches.en: THE COPY: a second version made to match a thing or a work of art detail for detail.
branches.cn: 副本：照着原物或艺术品逐处做出的第二份。

branches.en: THE REPEATED RUN: the procedure is gone through again, once or several times, to see whether the result holds.
branches.cn: 重复的运行：把程序再走一遍或几遍，看结果是否站得住。

branches.en: THE SELF-COPY: a cell or a strand of genetic material makes its own duplicate.
branches.cn: 自我复制：细胞或遗传物质链制造自己的副本。

branches.en: THE CARRIED PATTERN: a result or success is reproduced in another place and still holds.
branches.cn: 被带走的花样：结果或成功经验在另一处再现而仍然成立。

branches.en: THE FOLD, THE DATA AND THE OLD REPLY: the literal folded leaf, the duplicate kept on another server, and the archaic answer.
branches.cn: 折叶、数据与旧日答复：字面意义上向后折的叶片、存在另一台服务器上的副本，以及古老的答复之义。

intro.en: Replicate is a Latin verb of folding; its parts are still productive in English and its derived nouns carry the laboratory sense.
intro.cn: replicate 是一个表示折叠的拉丁动词，其构件在英语中仍有构词力，派生名词则带上实验室里的含义。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb replicare is the direct source, with the prefix re- and the root plicare visible in related English words.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词 replicare 是直接来源，前缀与词根在相关英语词中仍看得见。

items.example: The verb carries both the fold and the repeat.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词同时带着折叠与重复两层意思。

items.example: It marks a movement back toward the starting point.
items.exampleCN: 它标出朝起点折返的动作。

items.example: The root supplies the physical image behind the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供词语背后的具体意象。

items.meaning: the act of copying or repeating
items.example: The suffix turns the verb into the name of a process.
items.exampleCN: 后缀把动词变成过程之名。

items.example: The noun names the finished copy rather than the act.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指做成的副本，而非动作。

items.meaning: able to be copied or repeated
items.example: The adjective is central to debates about trustworthy science.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词在关于科学可信度的争论中处于中心。

items.example: The noun names the standard a result must meet.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指结果必须达到的标准。

items.example: Biology uses it for the copying phase of a cell.
items.exampleCN: 生物学用它指细胞的复制阶段。

items.example: The suffix marks the doer or the device.
items.exampleCN: 后缀标出执行者或装置。

latinEntries.meaning: to fold back; to repeat; to reply
latinEntries.example: Latin replicare means to fold back, and later to reply.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 replicare 意为折回，后来又指答复。

latinEntries.structure: Latin verb plicare (plic-, plicatum; to fold)
latinEntries.example: Latin plicare means to fold, and gives complicate and explicit.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 plicare 意为折叠，并给出 complicate 与 explicit。

latinEntries.example: Latin re- appears in reducere, to lead back.
latinEntries.exampleCN: 拉丁语 re- 见于 reducere（引回）。

derivatives.zh: 复制；重复实验；自我复制

definition_en: to act or speak for someone, to stand for something, or to show something in a picture or description
core_image: 一个人站在一群人前面，把大家的意思带到会议桌上
scene: 村里选出一个人去城里开会，他要代表所有住户表达对修路的需求。She was chosen to represent the village at the meeting.
sceneCN: 这里 represent 是「代表」（第 1 个义项：代替某人或某群体发言、行事）；句意：她被选出来代表全村去开会。

senses.title: To act or speak for others
senses.definition: to act or speak officially for a person, group, or organization
senses.definitionCN: 正式代替某人、某群体或某组织行事或发言
senses.example: The lawyer represents several families in the case.
senses.exampleCN: 这位律师在案件中代表好几个家庭。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to make present, so representing is making an absent group present through one person.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「使在场」，所以代表就是让不在场的群体通过一个人「到场」。

senses.title: To stand for something
senses.definition: to be a sign or symbol of something
senses.definitionCN: 作为某事物的标志或象征
senses.example: On the map, a red dot represents a hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 在地图上，红点表示医院。
senses.why: A symbol makes an idea present to the eye, which is the same logic as a person standing for a group.
senses.whyCN: 符号让一个概念在眼前「在场」，这与人代表群体的逻辑相同。

senses.title: To show in picture or words
senses.definition: to describe or show something in a particular way
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式描述或呈现某事物
senses.example: The painting represents the harvest as a celebration.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅画把丰收描绘成一场庆典。
senses.why: A picture makes a scene present again, extending the core idea from people to images.
senses.whyCN: 图画让一个场景再次「在场」，把核心概念从人扩展到图像。

senses.title: To amount to something
senses.definition: to be equivalent to something, or to count as an example of it
senses.definitionCN: 等同于某事物，或算作某事物的一例
senses.example: The delay represents a serious loss for the company.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误对公司来说相当于严重损失。
senses.why: If something stands for a value or result, it can also count as that result in practice.
senses.whyCN: 如果某物代表某种价值或结果，它在实际中也就可以算作那个结果。

intro.en: Represent comes from Latin repraesentare, to make present, built from re- and praesentare, to present.
intro.cn: represent 来自拉丁语 repraesentare（使在场），由 re- 与 praesentare（呈现）构成。

items.en: Praesens means present or being at hand, and praesentare means to make present.
items.cn: praesens 意为在场的、手边的，praesentare 意为使在场。

items.en: Repraesentare adds re- and means to bring something before the eyes or mind.
items.cn: repraesentare 加上 re-，意为把某物带到眼前或心中。

items.en: The verb is used for showing an image, a person, or an idea.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁语中，该动词用于呈现图像、人物或观念。

items.en: Old French representer carries the senses of showing and standing for.
items.cn: 古法语 representer 同时有「展示」和「代表」的意思。

items.en: Middle English represent covers speaking for others and depicting scenes.
items.cn: 中古英语 represent 涵盖替人发言和描绘场景。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of amounting to or constituting something.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「相当于、构成」这一义项。

note.en: Represent is the verb at the centre of a family about standing in for something, and it sits near words for symbol and depiction.
note.cn: represent 是「代替某物出场」这一词族的中心动词，与表示象征和描绘的词相邻。

entries.definition: the act of representing or something that represents
a person chosen to act for others
showing things as they appear in real life
to be a symbol of something
to show something in a picture or description
to give a visible or concrete form to an idea
to be a sign or short form of something

normalIntro.en: Represent is re- plus present, so the memory hook is making something present again through a person, sign, or picture.
normalIntro.cn: represent 就是 re- 加 present，记忆钩子是「通过人、符号或图画让某物再次在场」。

normal.en: Re- means again, and present means here: make the group present again through one speaker.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，present 表示在场：通过一个发言者让群体再次到场。

normal.en: A red dot on a map represents a hospital by making it visible.
normal.cn: 地图上的红点通过「可见」来代表医院。

normal.en: The ending -ation turns the verb into the noun representation.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ation 把动词变成名词 representation。

normal.en: The ending -ative turns it into representative, the person or the adjective.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ative 把它变成 representative，可指人或作形容词。

normal.en: Represent an improvement means the thing amounts to an improvement.
normal.cn: represent an improvement 意为该事物相当于一种改进。

abstract.en: Picture one person carrying a whole village's questions into a meeting room.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人把整个村子的问题带进会议室。

abstract.en: Imagine a small icon standing in for a large building on a screen.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上一枚小图标代替一栋大楼。

abstract.en: Think of a portrait making an absent face look present.
abstract.cn: 想象一幅肖像让不在场的面孔重新出现。

examples.en: She represents the company in Asia.
examples.cn: 她代表公司在亚洲开展工作。

examples.en: In this diagram, each circle represents a cell.
examples.cn: 在这张图里，每个圆圈表示一个细胞。

examples.en: The new rules represent a major change.
examples.cn: 新规定相当于一次重大变化。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（再次）+ present（呈现）＝让不在场的人或事再次呈现，即代表；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ praesens（在场的）→ praesentare（使在场）→ repraesentare（呈现、代表）→ 古法语 representer → 中古英语 represent。

sensesIntro.en: Making something present is the core: a person makes a group present, a sign makes an idea present, a picture makes a scene present, and a fact can make a result present.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「使某物在场」：人让群体在场，符号让观念在场，图画让场景在场，而事实可以让结果在场。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one person or sign standing in so that something absent becomes present.
core.cn: 核心意象：由一个人或符号代替出场，使缺席之物重新在场。

branches.en: Acting for a group is the central political and legal sense.
branches.cn: 替群体行事，是最核心的政治与法律义项。

branches.en: A symbol makes an idea present to the eye.
branches.cn: 符号让观念在眼前呈现。

branches.en: A picture makes a scene present again in description.
branches.cn: 图画在描述中让场景再次呈现。

branches.en: A fact can make a consequence present by counting as it.
branches.cn: 事实可以通过「算作」某种后果而使之在场。

branches.en: Delegates and symbols both stand in for something larger.
branches.cn: 代表与符号都在代替更大的事物出场。

intro.en: Represent is built from Latin parts, and its English family grows through noun and adjective endings.
intro.cn: represent 由拉丁语成分构成，其英语词族通过名词和形容词词尾扩展。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- adds again, and praesentare means to make present, from praesens, present.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 增添「再次」，praesentare 意为「使在场」，来自 praesens（在场的）。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 represent 与 present 开头。

items.example: Praesens is the source of the present element.
items.exampleCN: praesens 是 present 这一成分的来源。

items.example: Praesentare gives represent its showing sense.
items.exampleCN: praesentare 给 represent 提供「呈现」的含义。
repraesentare 由 re- 与 praesentare 合成。

items.example: Represent carries the Latin verb into English.
items.exampleCN: represent 把拉丁动词带入英语。

items.meaning: the act or result of representing
items.exampleCN: representation 在 represent 后加 -ation。
representative 在 represent 后加 -ative。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ation 构成 representation。
词尾 -ative 构成 representative。

definition_zh: 代表；代理人；典型的；有代表性的
definition_en: a person chosen to speak or act for a group, or something that is typical of a larger whole
core_image: 会议室里写着「村民代表」的牌子前，坐着一个被大家推选出来的人
scene: 全国各地的代表聚到首都，把各自选区的声音带进会场。Each representative carried the concerns of a different region.
sceneCN: 这里 representative 是「代表」（第 1 个义项：被选出替群体发言的人）；句意：每位代表都带来了不同地区的关切。

senses.title: A person chosen to act for others
senses.definition: someone who is chosen to speak or vote for a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 被选出替一群人发言或投票的人
senses.example: The union sent three representatives to the talks.
senses.exampleCN: 工会派了三名代表参加会谈。
senses.why: The -ative ending marks a person or thing that carries out the action of representing.
senses.whyCN: -ative 词尾标记执行「代表」这一动作的人或物。

senses.title: A typical example
senses.definition: typical of a group, so that it can be used as an example of the whole
senses.definitionCN: 能体现整个群体特征的，可作为整体的例子
senses.example: The survey used a representative sample of adults.
senses.exampleCN: 这项调查使用了有代表性的成年人样本。
senses.why: If a person stands for a group, a sample can stand for a whole population in the same way.
senses.whyCN: 如果一个人能代表一个群体，一个样本也能以同样方式代表整个人群。

senses.title: Based on elected members
senses.definition: describing a system in which elected people make decisions for the public
senses.definitionCN: 描述由民选代表替公众作决定的制度
senses.example: The country has a representative government.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家实行代议制政府。
senses.why: A government made of representatives is simply the adjective form applied to a whole system.
senses.whyCN: 由代表组成的政府，只是把这个形容词用在整个制度上。

intro.en: Representative is formed inside English by adding -ative to represent, which comes from Latin repraesentare.
intro.cn: representative 是英语在 represent 后加 -ative 构成的，而 represent 来自拉丁语 repraesentare。

items.en: Repraesentare means to make present or bring before the eyes.
items.cn: repraesentare 意为使在场或带到眼前。

items.en: The ending -ativus marks something that performs or relates to an action.
items.cn: 词尾 -ativus 标记执行某动作或与之相关的事物。

items.en: Old French representer brings the verb into English.
items.cn: 古法语 representer 把动词带入英语。

items.en: Middle English uses representative for a person who stands for others.
items.cn: 中古英语用 representative 指替他人出场的人。

items.en: Political theory adopts representative for elected government.
items.cn: 政治理论采用 representative 指代议制政府。

items.en: Modern English extends it to samples and typical examples.
items.cn: 现代英语把它扩展到样本和典型例子。

note.en: Representative is the person-or-adjective form of the represent family, and it is close to names for delegates and typical examples.
note.cn: representative 是 represent 词族中「人」或形容词的形态，与代表和典型例子的名称相邻。

entries.definition: to speak or act for others
the act of representing
showing things as they appear
a person sent to speak or vote for a group
a person who acts for someone else
a person who speaks officially for a group
showing the usual qualities of a group

normalIntro.en: Representative contains represent plus -ative, and the ending signals either a person who represents or an adjective meaning typical.
normalIntro.cn: representative 由 represent 加 -ative 构成，词尾要么指「执行代表的人」，要么是形容词「典型的」。

normal.en: Represent plus -ative: a person who does the representing.
normal.cn: represent 加 -ative：执行代表动作的人。

normal.en: A sales representative is the person who stands for the company to customers.
normal.cn: sales representative 就是公司对客户出面的那个人。

normal.en: A representative sample stands for the whole population.
normal.cn: representative sample 代表整个人群。

normal.en: Elected representative makes the political role explicit.
normal.cn: elected representative 明确点出政治角色。

normal.en: Representative of can mean typical of as well as speaking for.
normal.cn: representative of 既可指「代表」，也可指「典型体现」。

abstract.en: Picture a name card on a long table, marking one seat as the village's seat.
abstract.cn: 想象长桌上的一张名牌，把某个座位标为村子的座位。

abstract.en: Imagine one apple chosen to stand for a whole crate.
abstract.cn: 想象一个苹果被选出来代表整箱苹果。

abstract.en: Think of a spokesperson stepping up to a row of microphones.
abstract.cn: 想象发言人走到一排麦克风前。

examples.en: Each department elected a representative to the committee.
examples.cn: 每个部门都选了一名代表进入委员会。

examples.en: The study used a representative sample of students.
examples.cn: 这项研究使用了有代表性的学生样本。

examples.en: The painting is representative of his early style.
examples.cn: 这幅画代表了他的早期风格。

dict_mnemonic.text: represent（代表）+ -ative（人／形容词词尾）＝代表或典型的；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: represent（代表，源自拉丁语 repraesentare「使在场」）+ 词尾 -ative，表示执行代表动作的人，或具有代表性的事物。

sensesIntro.en: The person comes first, then the typical sample that stands for a whole, then the whole system built from such people.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是代人行事的人，再是代表整体的典型样本，最后是由这些人构成的整套制度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one chosen person or sample standing in for a larger whole.
core.cn: 核心意象：被选出的一个人或样本，代替更大的整体出场。

branches.en: The chosen person who speaks for others is the basic sense.
branches.cn: 被选出替他人发言的人，是基本义项。

branches.en: A sample can stand for a population just as a person stands for a group.
branches.cn: 样本代表总体，正如人代表群体。

branches.en: A whole system can be built out of elected representatives.
branches.cn: 整套制度可以由民选代表构成。

branches.en: Person and sample both work by standing in for something larger.
branches.cn: 人与样本都通过代替更大的事物来发挥作用。

branches.en: Elected individuals and representative government share the same political logic.
branches.cn: 民选个人与代议制政府共享同一套政治逻辑。

intro.en: Representative is an English adjective-and-noun form built on the Latin verb represent.
intro.cn: representative 是在拉丁动词 represent 基础上构成的英语形容词兼名词。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ending -ativus marks something that performs an action, so representative names the one who makes others present.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词尾 -ativus 标记执行动作的事物，所以 representative 指「使他人出场的人」。

items.example: Represent is the base of representative.
items.exampleCN: represent 是 representative 的基础词。
词尾 -ative 构成 representative。
representative 由 represent 与 -ative 合成。
representatives 在 representative 后加 -s。
representation 共享 represent 词干。
representational 共享 represent 词干。
representativeness 在 representative 后加 -ness。
词尾 -ness 构成 representativeness。

definition_en: to produce young, or to make a copy of something so that it can be seen or heard again
core_image: 一台复印机把同一页纸一张张吐出来，图案几乎一模一样
scene: 春天的池塘里，青蛙产下卵，几周后小蝌蚪成群游动。Frogs reproduce in shallow water every spring.
sceneCN: 这里 reproduce 是「繁殖」（第 1 个义项：生物产生后代）；句意：青蛙每年春天在浅水里繁殖。

senses.title: To produce young
senses.definition: for a living thing to produce young or new individuals
senses.definitionCN: 生物产生幼体或新的个体
senses.example: These birds reproduce once a year.
senses.exampleCN: 这些鸟每年繁殖一次。
senses.why: The word is re- plus produce, and life producing new life is the most literal kind of producing again.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 re- 加 produce，生命产生新的生命，正是最字面的「再次生产」。

senses.title: To make a copy
senses.definition: to make a copy of a document, picture, or object
senses.definitionCN: 制作文件、图片或物品的副本
senses.example: The machine can reproduce the page in colour.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器可以彩色复制这一页。
senses.why: Copying produces the same thing again, matching the re- pattern without any living sense.
senses.whyCN: 复制是把同样的东西再做出来，符合 re- 的模式，但与生物无关。

senses.title: To recreate sound or image
senses.definition: to play or show a recording so that a sound or picture appears again
senses.definitionCN: 播放录音或影像，使声音或画面再次出现
senses.example: The old tape still reproduces her voice clearly.
senses.exampleCN: 这盘旧磁带仍能清楚地重现她的声音。
senses.why: A recording keeps a sound and produces it again later, which is another form of producing again.
senses.whyCN: 录音把声音保存下来，日后再次放出，是「再次生产」的另一种形式。

senses.title: To produce results again
senses.definition: to obtain the same result again in an experiment or process
senses.definitionCN: 在实验或过程中再次得到同样的结果
senses.example: Other labs could not reproduce the findings.
senses.exampleCN: 其他实验室无法重现这些发现。
senses.why: Science uses the word for making a result appear again, extending it from objects to outcomes.
senses.whyCN: 科学用它表示让结果再次出现，把词义从物件扩展到结果。

intro.en: Reproduce is an English formation from re-, again, and produce, from Latin producere, to lead forth.
intro.cn: reproduce 是英语用 re-（再次）与 produce（源自拉丁语 producere「引出」）构成的词。

items.en: Producere means to lead or bring forth, from pro-, forward, and ducere, to lead.
items.cn: producere 意为引出、带出，由 pro-（向前）与 ducere（引导）构成。

items.en: The noun productum names something brought forth or produced.
items.cn: 名词 productum 指被引出或生产出来的东西。

items.en: English produce appears with the sense of bringing something into being.
items.cn: 英语 produce 出现，表示使某物产生。

items.en: Reproduce is formed to mean produce again, especially living offspring.
items.cn: reproduce 被构成，表示再次生产，尤指产生后代。

items.en: Printing and photography give the word the sense of making copies.
items.cn: 印刷与摄影赋予这个词「复制」的含义。

items.en: Modern English adds recorded sound and repeated experimental results.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了录音再现和实验结果复现的用法。

note.en: Reproduce joins the produce family to the prefix re-, and it sits beside words for breeding and copying.
note.cn: reproduce 把 produce 词族与前缀 re- 结合，与表示繁殖和复制的词相邻。

entries.definition: the act of reproducing, or a copy
relating to producing young
able to be copied or repeated
to produce young animals
to make something look the same as another
to copy something exactly, especially in an experiment
to make an exact second copy

normalIntro.en: Reproduce is re- plus produce, so the whole word means produce again, whether that is offspring, a copy, a sound, or a result.
normalIntro.cn: reproduce 就是 re- 加 produce，整个词意为「再次生产」，无论是后代、副本、声音还是结果。

normal.en: Re- means again, and produce means bring forth: bring forth again.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，produce 表示生产：再次生产出来。

normal.en: Animals reproduce by producing young.
normal.cn: 动物通过产生幼体来繁殖。

normal.en: A photocopier reproduces a page.
normal.cn: 复印机复制一页纸。

normal.en: A speaker reproduces recorded sound.
normal.cn: 扬声器再现录制的声音。

normal.en: A good experiment can be reproduced by another lab.
normal.cn: 好的实验能被另一个实验室复现。

abstract.en: Picture one page sliding out of a copier as an identical page.
abstract.cn: 想象一页纸从复印机里滑出，变成一模一样的一页。

abstract.en: Imagine a pond filling with tadpoles in spring.
abstract.cn: 想象春天的池塘里挤满蝌蚪。

abstract.en: Think of a voice held in a tape and released years later.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音被封存在磁带里，多年后再次放出。

examples.en: Bacteria reproduce very quickly in warm conditions.
examples.cn: 细菌在温暖环境中繁殖得很快。

examples.en: The gallery reproduced the famous painting for the exhibition.
examples.cn: 美术馆为展览复制了那幅名画。

examples.en: No other team could reproduce the result.
examples.cn: 没有其他团队能重现这个结果。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（再次）+ produce（生产）＝再生产，即繁殖或复制；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: re-（再次）+ produce（生产，源自拉丁语 producere「引出」）→ 17 世纪英语构成，本义「再生产」，后扩展为繁殖、复制、再现。

sensesIntro.en: Producing again starts with living offspring, then copies of objects, then recorded sound, and finally the reappearance of a scientific result.
sensesIntro.cn: 「再次生产」从生命后代开始，再到物件副本，再到录制的声音，最后是科学结果的再次出现。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same thing produced once more, from a new animal to a new copy.
core.cn: 核心意象：同样的东西再被生产一次，从新的生命到新的副本。

branches.en: Living things producing young is the biological sense.
branches.cn: 生物产生后代，是生物学义项。

branches.en: Making a copy is the same repetition applied to objects.
branches.cn: 制作副本，是同样的重复作用在物件上。

branches.en: Replaying sound or image makes a past moment appear again.
branches.cn: 重放声音或影像，让过去的瞬间再次出现。

branches.en: Repeating an experimental result is reproduction in science.
branches.cn: 重复实验结果，是科学中的「复现」。

branches.en: Offspring and copies both carry the same pattern into a new instance.
branches.cn: 后代与副本都把同样的模式带入新的个体。

intro.en: Reproduce combines the Latin prefix re- with produce, itself built from Latin pro- and ducere.
intro.cn: reproduce 把拉丁前缀 re- 与 produce 结合，而 produce 本身由拉丁语 pro- 与 ducere 构成。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, pro- means forward, and ducere means to lead, so producere is to lead forth.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示再次，pro- 表示向前，ducere 表示引导，所以 producere 就是「引出」。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 reproduce 开头。

items.example: Pro- appears in produce and proceed.
items.exampleCN: pro- 出现在 produce 与 proceed 中。

items.example: Ducere is the root of produce.
items.exampleCN: ducere 是 produce 的词根。
producere 由 pro- 与 ducere 合成。

items.example: Produce is the base of reproduce.
items.exampleCN: produce 是 reproduce 的基础词。
reproduce 在 produce 前加 re-。
reproduction 在 reproduce 后加 -tion。
reproductive 在 reproduce 后加 -ive。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -tion 构成 reproduction。
词尾 -ive 构成 reproductive。

definition_zh: 可重复性；可复现性；再现性；复现能力
definition_en: the ability of a result or experiment to be obtained again by the same or another researcher
core_image: 两间实验室各摆一套相同的仪器，两张记录纸上画着几乎一样的曲线
scene: 两间实验室各摆着一套相同的仪器，两位技术员按同一份步骤各做一遍，两张记录纸上画出几乎一样的曲线。The reproducibility of the assay was checked in two labs before the paper was submitted.
sceneCN: 这里指他人按同样条件能再次得到相同结果的程度（第 1 个义项：结果能被再次得到的性质）；句意为论文投稿之前，这项检测的可重复性已在两间实验室核对过。图中可辨识物件：两套仪器、记录纸、曲线、操作步骤单。

pos.zh: 可重复性；可复现性；再现性

senses.title: The result can be obtained again
senses.definition: the degree to which the same result can be obtained again under the same conditions
senses.definitionCN: 在相同条件下能再次得到同一结果的程度
senses.example: The reproducibility of the assay was checked in two labs before the paper was submitted.
senses.exampleCN: 论文投稿之前，这项检测的可重复性已在两间实验室核对过。
senses.why: Reproduce joins re- again to produce, so the noun names the ability to bring the same result forth again.
senses.whyCN: 动词把表示「再次」的前缀加到「产出」之上，名词便命名「再次产出同一结果」的能力。

senses.title: The experiment can be repeated
senses.definition: the quality of an experiment whose whole procedure can be followed again by another team
senses.definitionCN: 整套步骤能被另一个团队照着再做一遍的性质
senses.example: Careful reproducibility requires a protocol that another team can follow.
senses.exampleCN: 要做到可重复，研究方案必须详细到另一个团队能照着做。
senses.why: The word covers the procedure as well as the number, because a result cannot return without the steps.
senses.whyCN: 这个词既覆盖步骤也覆盖数值，因为没有步骤，结果就回不来。

senses.title: The crisis of missing repeats
senses.definition: the public concern that many published findings cannot be repeated
senses.definitionCN: 许多已发表发现无法被重复所引发的公共担忧
senses.example: The conference was called to discuss the reproducibility crisis in psychology.
senses.exampleCN: 这次会议专门讨论心理学中的可重复性危机。
senses.why: When many claims fail the test, the quality becomes the name of a field-wide problem.
senses.whyCN: 当许多主张都过不了这道检验，这种性质就成了整个领域的问题之名。

senses.title: The stability of an instrument
senses.definition: the consistency of readings given by an instrument on repeated measurement
senses.definitionCN: 仪器反复测量同一对象时读数的稳定性
senses.example: The reproducibility of the balance was tested with the same standard block.
senses.exampleCN: 天平的再现性用同一块标准砝码作了检验。
senses.why: Instruments also produce again, and their reproducibility is a property of the machine.
senses.whyCN: 仪器也会再次产出，它的再现性是机器本身的属性。

senses.title: Batch-to-batch repeatability
senses.titleCN: 批与批之间的再现精度
senses.definition: the consistency of a manufactured product from one batch to the next
senses.definitionCN: 制成品从一批到下一批的一致性
senses.example: The plant records the reproducibility of each batch within narrow limits.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂把每一批的再现精度都记录在很窄的范围内。
senses.why: Manufacturing asks the same question as science: can the same thing be made again?
senses.whyCN: 制造业问的与科学同一个问题：同样的东西还能再做一次吗？

senses.title: The same code gives the same output
senses.titleCN: 同一代码给出同一输出
senses.definition: the ability to rerun an analysis from the same data and code and obtain the same output
senses.definitionCN: 用同一数据与代码重跑分析、得到同一输出的能力
senses.example: Computational reproducibility means the same code gives the same output.
senses.exampleCN: 计算可复现性意味着同一份代码给出同一份输出。
senses.why: Computers brought a new kind of repeatability, where the steps are files rather than hands.
senses.whyCN: 计算机带来一种新的可重复性，步骤是文件而不是人手。

senses.title: The standard a journal demands
senses.titleCN: 期刊要求的可重复标准
senses.definition: a formal requirement that authors provide enough material for others to repeat the work
senses.definitionCN: 要求作者提供足够材料、使他人能重复这项工作的正式规定
senses.example: The journal now enforces a reproducibility standard for its papers.
senses.exampleCN: 这家期刊现在对论文执行可重复性标准。
senses.why: Once the quality is valued, it becomes a rule that can be checked.
senses.whyCN: 这种性质一旦被看重，就变成可以核查的规则。

senses.title: The failure to repeat
senses.definition: the absence of reproducibility, when a second attempt does not produce the same result
senses.definitionCN: 缺乏可重复性，即第二次尝试没有得到同一结果
senses.example: The lack of reproducibility in the earlier study delayed the drug's approval.
senses.exampleCN: 早先研究缺乏可重复性，拖延了这种药的批准。
senses.why: The noun can name the failure as well as the virtue, because both are measured by the second attempt.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词既能命名美德也能命名失败，因为两者都由第二次尝试来衡量。

intro.en: Reproducibility is reproduce plus -ible plus -ity, a Latin-derived stack. Reproduce comes from re- again and Latin producere, to lead forward. The source is clear; the date of the noun's first record is uncertain.
intro.cn: 这个词由「产出」动词先加表示「能够」的后缀，再加表示「性质」的后缀构成。该动词来自表示「再次」的前缀与拉丁 producere「向前引出」。词源清楚，名词最早记录的年代不确定。

items.en: Ducere meant to lead, and it stands inside producere as the moving element.
items.cn: ducere 意为引导，作为「带动」的成分藏在 producere 里。

items.en: Producere joined pro- forward to ducere, meaning to lead or bring forth.
items.cn: producere 把意为「向前」的前缀加到 ducere 上，意为引出、带出。

items.en: The prefix re- adds the sense of doing it once more, giving reproduce.
items.cn: 表示「再次」的前缀加上「再做一次」的意思，构成「再次产出」的动词。

items.en: Latin -ibilis means able to be, so reproducible means able to be produced again.
items.cn: 拉丁语 -ibilis 意为「能够被……」，因此「可复现的」指能够被再次产出。

items.en: Latin -itas turns the adjective into the name of the quality.
items.cn: 拉丁语 -itas 把形容词变成这种性质的名称。

items.en: Twentieth-century science made reproducibility a technical demand; the phrase reproducibility crisis is recent, and its first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 二十世纪科学使这个词成为技术要求；「可重复性危机」这一说法出现较晚，起始年代不确定。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like reproducibility; the second names qualities it is often confused with.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「本词」相近；第二组是常与它混淆的性质。

entries.definition: To produce again, or to make offspring.
The adjective for something that can be produced again.
entries.definitionCN: 指能够被再次产出的形容词。

entries.definition: The adverb for doing something in a repeatable way.
entries.definitionCN: 以可重复的方式做某事的副词。

entries.definition: The act of copying or the process of producing offspring.
Relating to producing offspring.
The chance of getting the same result when one person repeats the same measurement.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个人重复同一测量时得到同一结果的机会。

entries.definition: The chance that another team can repeat a study and find the same result.
entries.definitionCN: 另一个团队重复研究并得到同一结果的机会。

entries.definition: Consistency of measurement over time, a narrower quality.
entries.definitionCN: 测量随时间的稳定性，是一种更窄的性质。

entries.definition: Agreement among repeated results, without saying they are right.
entries.definitionCN: 多次结果彼此一致，但不说明它们是对的。

entries.definition: The tendency to stay the same rather than to be produced again.
entries.definitionCN: 倾向于保持不变，而不是再次被产出。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin produce word, the real -ible and -ity stack and real science terms.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「产出」词、真实的「能够」与「性质」两个后缀叠加，以及真实科学术语。

normal.en: Reproducibility is reproduce plus -ible plus -ity: the ability to be produced again.
normal.cn: reproducibility 是 reproduce 加 -ible 再加 -ity：能够被再次产出的能力。

normal.en: Producere meant to lead forward, and re- adds a second leading.
normal.cn: producere 意为向前引出，re- 又加上第二次引出。

normal.en: Fixed phrases include reproducibility crisis, reproducibility standard and computational reproducibility.
normal.cn: 固定说法有可重复性危机、可重复性标准与计算可复现性。

normal.en: Two labs, one protocol and nearly one curve: that is reproducibility in a picture.
normal.cn: 两间实验室、一份步骤、几乎一条曲线：这就是可重复性的画面。

normal.en: A journal that enforces a reproducibility standard is asking for the steps, not just the answer.
normal.cn: 执行可重复性标准的期刊，要的是步骤，不只是答案。

abstract.en: Reproducibility is the promise that the second try will not tell a different story.
abstract.cn: 可重复性是那个承诺：第二次尝试不会讲出另一个故事。

abstract.en: A result that no one can produce again is a rumour with numbers attached.
abstract.cn: 没人能再次产出的结果，只是带着数字的传闻。

abstract.en: The word measures science against its own claim to be public knowledge.
abstract.cn: 这个词用科学自称的「公共知识」来衡量科学本身。

examples.en: The team improved the reproducibility by writing down every step.
examples.cn: 团队把每一步都写下来，从而提高了可重复性。

examples.en: Reproducibility is now a condition for funding in some fields.
examples.cn: 在某些领域，可重复性如今是获得资助的条件。

examples.en: The report ranked the studies by their reproducibility.
examples.cn: 报告按可重复性对这些研究作了排序。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「再次产出的能力」——同一结果还能再做出来：可重复性

root: 这个词由意为「再次」的前缀、意为「产出」的词根与表示「能够」「性质」的两个后缀叠加构成。词根源自拉丁 producere「向前引出」（前缀意为「向前」加词根意为「引导」）。二十世纪科学使它成为技术术语，二〇一〇年代前后出现「可重复性危机」说法；词源清楚，最早记录年代不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one second attempt: the same result again, the repeatable experiment, the crisis of failed repeats, instrument stability, batch consistency, computational replay, a journal standard, and the failure to repeat.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项跟着同一次「第二次尝试」：再次得到同一结果、可重复的实验、复现失败的危机、仪器稳定性、批次一致性、计算重跑、期刊标准，以及无法重复的失败。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two labs, one protocol, and two record sheets carrying almost the same curve.
core.cn: 核心意象：两间实验室、一份步骤，两张记录纸上画着几乎一样的曲线。

branches.en: THE RESULT AND THE PROCEDURE: the number returns, and the steps make its return possible.
branches.cn: 结果与步骤：数值回来了，而步骤使这个回来成为可能。

branches.en: THE CRISIS: when many results fail to return, the quality becomes a public problem.
branches.cn: 危机：当许多结果回不来，这种性质就成了公共问题。

branches.en: THE MACHINE AND THE FACTORY: instruments and batches must give the same reading or the same product.
branches.cn: 仪器与工厂：仪器与批次必须给出同一读数或同一产品。

branches.en: THE CODE AND THE RULE: a replay from files, and a journal that demands the files.
branches.cn: 代码与规则：从文件重跑，以及要求交出文件的期刊。

branches.en: THE FAILURE: the same word names the absence of the quality.
branches.cn: 失败：同一个词也命名这种性质的缺失。

intro.en: Reproducibility is a three-part Latin stack on an English verb: re- plus produce plus -ible plus -ity.
intro.cn: reproducibility 是在英语动词上叠三层拉丁成分：re- 加 produce 再加 -ible 与 -ity。

latinIntro.en: Latin producere, ducere and the endings -ibilis and -itas supply the structure of the word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 producere、ducere 与后缀 -ibilis、-itas 提供这个词的结构。

items.example: The verb supplies the producing inside the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供词里的「产出」。

items.example: The root is the moving element in many English words.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根是许多英语词里的「带动」成分。

items.example: The prefix asks for a second producing.
items.exampleCN: 前缀要求第二次产出。

items.example: The verb names the act of bringing back a result.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指把结果再次带回来的行为。

items.example: It builds reproducible from the verb.
items.exampleCN: 它由动词构成表示「可复现的」形容词。

items.example: It builds reproducibility from the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它由形容词构成表示「可重复性」的名词。

items.example: The adjective describes the result or the procedure.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词描述结果或步骤。

items.example: The adverb marks how the work was done.
items.exampleCN: 副词标出工作是怎样做的。

definition_zh: 繁殖；复制品；再生产；再现；声音还原；翻印
definition_en: the process of producing new individuals or new copies of something already made
core_image: 温室里，一株母株旁边并排长出三株一模一样的小苗，每片叶子的纹路都相同。
scene: 园艺师指着温室里的三株小苗说，它们都是从同一株母本繁殖出来的，叶形和花纹完全一样。These three seedlings are reproductions of a single parent plant, with exactly the same leaves.
sceneCN: 这里 reproduction 是“生物的繁殖”（第 1 个义项）；句意：这三株小苗由同一母本繁殖而来。

pos.zh: 繁殖；复制；复制品；再生产；再现

senses.title: Making new living things
senses.definition: the biological process by which organisms produce new individuals of their own kind
senses.definitionCN: 生物产生同类新个体的生物学过程
senses.example: Fungi can spread by asexual reproduction alone.
senses.exampleCN: 真菌可以仅靠无性繁殖扩散。
senses.why: The prefix re- means again and production means bringing forth; a species brings forth its kind again, so the same form returns in a new body.
senses.whyCN: 前缀 re- 表示“再一次”，production 表示“产出”；物种把自己的种类再一次产出，同一形制在新个体身上重现。

senses.title: A copy of a work
senses.titleCN: 复制品：仿照原件做出的成品
senses.definition: a copy of a painting, document, or object, often made later and worth less than the original
senses.definitionCN: 对绘画、文件或器物的仿制，通常晚于原件且价值较低
senses.example: The museum displays a reproduction of the tablet, not the original.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆展出的是那块泥板的复制品，而非原件。
senses.why: A copy brings the object forth again in another material; re- marks the second coming, and the copy is openly secondary.
senses.whyCN: 复制品用另一种材料把器物再一次产出；re- 标记第二次出现，而复制品本身就公开地处于次要地位。

senses.title: Rebuilding capital and labour
senses.titleCN: 再生产：经济体系把自身条件重新造出
senses.definition: the process by which an economy renews the capital, labour, and social relations it needs to continue
senses.definitionCN: 经济体系重新造出延续自身所需的资本、劳动力与社会关系的过程
senses.example: Marx argued that the wage relation secures the reproduction of labour power.
senses.exampleCN: 马克思主张，工资关系保证了劳动力的再生产。
senses.why: In economics the object reproduced is not a thing but the conditions of production; the system produces the means of producing again.
senses.whyCN: 在经济学中，被再生产的不是某件物品，而是生产条件本身；体系产出的是“再次生产的手段”。

senses.title: Bringing a scene back
senses.titleCN: 再现：把声音、画面或情境重放出来
senses.definition: the act of recreating a sound, image, or situation so that it can be experienced again
senses.definitionCN: 把声音、图像或情境重新造出，使人能再次体验
senses.example: The recording gives a faithful reproduction of the concert hall's acoustics.
senses.exampleCN: 这段录音忠实再现了音乐厅的声学效果。
senses.why: Here the thing reproduced is an experience rather than an object; fidelity is judged by how little the listener notices the medium.
senses.whyCN: 这里复制的是体验而不是物件；还原的忠実程度，取决于听众多不容易察觉媒介的存在。

senses.title: How well sound or colour comes back
senses.titleCN: 还原度：音响与色彩的再现质量
senses.definition: the quality with which a recording or display recreates sound or colour
senses.definitionCN: 录音或显示设备重现声音或色彩的质量
senses.example: Cheap speakers give poor reproduction of low notes.
senses.exampleCN: 廉价音箱对低音的还原很差。
senses.why: The word shifts from the act to the standard of the result: a system has good reproduction when little of the original is lost.
senses.whyCN: 词义从动作转到结果的标准：当原物损失很少时，系统就有良好的还原度。

senses.title: Breeding behaviour
senses.titleCN: 生殖活动：求偶、产卵与育幼
senses.definition: the behaviour and timing by which animals or plants breed
senses.definitionCN: 动物或植物繁殖的行为与时间安排
senses.example: Day length triggers reproduction in many temperate birds.
senses.exampleCN: 日照长度触发许多温带鸟类的生殖活动。
senses.why: Reproduction as a countable, seasonal event is the biological process seen from the calendar rather than from the cell.
senses.whyCN: 作为可按季节计数的事件，这一义项是从日历而不是从细胞层面看繁殖过程。

senses.title: Copying documents
senses.titleCN: 翻印：文件与图像的机械复制
senses.definition: the mechanical copying of documents, images, or recordings
senses.definitionCN: 对文件、图像或录音的机械复制
senses.example: The archive restricts reproduction of fragile manuscripts.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆限制对易损手稿的翻印。
senses.why: Printing and photography detached copying from the hand; reproduction then names an industrial service rather than a likeness made by an artist.
senses.whyCN: 印刷与摄影把手工复制与原件分离；reproduction 由此指一种工业服务，而不是艺术家的仿作。

senses.title: Passing inequality along
senses.titleCN: 社会再生产：把不平等传给下一代
senses.definition: in sociology, the way families and schools transmit advantage and disadvantage across generations
senses.definitionCN: 社会学中指家庭与学校把优势与劣势跨代传递的方式
senses.example: The study examines the reproduction of class differences through schooling.
senses.exampleCN: 这项研究考察阶级差异如何通过学校教育被再生产。
senses.why: Society reproduces itself by reproducing its divisions; nothing is copied deliberately, yet the pattern returns.
senses.whyCN: 社会通过再生产自身的分层来延续自身；没有人刻意复制，格局却照样重现。

intro.en: Reproduction is re- plus production. Production goes back to Latin producere, to lead forth, from pro-, forward, and ducere, to lead.
intro.cn: reproduction 是 re- 加 production。production 可追溯到拉丁语 producere“引出、带出”，由 pro-“向前”与 ducere“引导”构成。

items.en: Ducere meant to lead or draw. Nearly every English word in this family carries the image of something being led out into view.
items.cn: ducere 意为“引导、牵引”。这一词族的英语词几乎都带着“把某物引出到眼前”的形象。

items.en: Producere joined pro-, forward, with ducere: to lead or bring forth, as a plant brings forth a shoot.
items.cn: producere 由 pro-“向前”与 ducere 组合：引出、带出，如同植物长出枝条。

items.en: Productio named a lengthening or a bringing forth; the noun kept the sense of extending something out from a source.
items.cn: productio 指拉长或引出；这个名词保留了“从源头把某物延伸出来”的意思。

items.en: English production first meant the act of bringing forth goods, plays, or arguments; the thing produced is secondary to the act.
items.cn: 英语 production 最初指产出货物、演出戏剧或提出论据的行为；被产出之物相对于动作是次要的。

items.en: The prefix re- means back or again. Added to production it marks a second bringing forth, whether of offspring or of copies.
items.cn: 前缀 re- 表示“回、再”。加在 production 上就标记第二次产出，无论产出的是后代还是复制品。

items.en: Reproduction is recorded in the 18th century for the generation of new organisms, and soon after for copies of artworks and printed matter.
items.cn: reproduction 的书面记录见于 18 世纪，指新个体的产生；不久后又指艺术品与印刷品的复制品。

note.en: The first group shares the produce root but differs in grammatical role; the second compares words for copies and for breeding.
note.cn: 第一组共享 produce 词根，但语法角色不同；第二组比较表示复制与繁殖的几个词。

entries.definition: to produce offspring or make a copy. It names the action.
entries.definitionCN: 繁殖或复制；命名的是动作。

entries.definition: relating to breeding or to copying. It describes what serves reproduction.
entries.definitionCN: 与繁殖或复制有关的；描述服务于繁殖或复制的事物。

entries.definition: able to be made again, especially of an experiment. It judges repeatability.
entries.definitionCN: 能够被再次做出的，尤指实验；评判的是可重复性。

entries.definition: an imitation of an original. It is the everyday word and carries no scientific sense.
entries.definitionCN: 对原件的仿制；是日常用词，不含科学含义。

entries.definition: an exact second version made for practical use, such as a spare key.
entries.definitionCN: 为实用目的做出的完全相同的第二份，如备用钥匙。

entries.definition: the controlled production of animals or plants by humans. It stresses human management.
entries.definitionCN: 人类对动植物繁殖的控制；强调人为管理。

entries.definition: the copying of a process or molecule, especially in science. It stresses exact repetition of a mechanism.
entries.definitionCN: 过程或分子的复制，尤用于科学；强调机制的精确重复。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: re-, production. Production comes from Latin producere, to lead forth, so reproduction is leading forth again.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：re- 与 production。production 出自拉丁语 producere“引出”，所以 reproduction 就是“再一次引出”。

normal.en: Re plus production: bring the same thing forth a second time.
normal.cn: re 加 production：把同样的东西第二次产出。

normal.en: A rabbit reproducing is a species bringing itself forth again.
normal.cn: 兔子繁殖，就是一个物种把自己再一次产出。

normal.en: A museum reproduction is an honest second body for an object that must stay safe.
normal.cn: 博物馆复制品是替必须妥善保存的原件做出的诚实的第二个身体。

normal.en: Good speakers have good reproduction: little of the original sound is lost.
normal.cn: 好音箱的还原度好：原声损失很少。

normal.en: Photocopying a manuscript is reproduction in the office, not in the greenhouse.
normal.cn: 复印手稿是办公室里的复制，不是温室里的繁殖。

abstract.en: Every copy is a claim about what mattered in the original.
abstract.cn: 每一件复制品都是关于“原件里什么才重要”的一次主张。

abstract.en: A society reproduces itself most quietly when nobody notices the pattern returning.
abstract.cn: 社会最安静地再生产自身的时刻，是没人注意到旧格局又回来的时候。

abstract.en: Reproduction without variation would end adaptation; copying always carries small errors.
abstract.cn: 没有变异的复制会终止适应；复制总带着微小的错误。

examples.en: Bacteria reproduce by splitting, so a single cell can found a colony in hours.
examples.cn: 细菌靠分裂繁殖，一个细胞数小时内就能建立菌落。

examples.en: The gallery sells reproductions of the frescoes to protect the originals from flash photography.
examples.cn: 美术馆出售壁画复制品，以保护原件不受闪光灯损害。

examples.en: The paper failed to report enough detail for reproduction of the experiment.
examples.cn: 这篇论文未报告足够细节，实验无法被重复。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（再）+ production（生产）——再生一次，既可指生后代，也可指复制品。

root: 由 re-（再、重新）加 production（产出，源自拉丁语 producere“引出”，由 pro-“向前”与 ducere“引导”构成）组合而成，本义为“把同一事物再一次产出”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of reproduction, all circling one idea: the same form comes back. What returns may be an organism, a copy, a set of economic conditions, a sound, colour fidelity, a seasonal brood, a printed page, or a social pattern.
sensesIntro.cn: reproduction 的八个义项都围绕一个观念：同一形制再次出现。回来的可以是生物个体、复制品、经济条件、声音、色彩还原、季节性繁殖、印刷页面，也可以是社会格局。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: three identical seedlings beside the mother plant in a greenhouse, every leaf vein matching.
core.cn: 核心意象：温室里母株旁并排三株一模一样的小苗，叶脉纹路全都相同。

chain: ENGLISH PRODUCTION THE ACT OF MAKING

branches.en: LIVING REPRODUCTION: the making of new individuals and the seasonal behaviour that times it.
branches.cn: 生命繁衍：新个体的产生，以及为之定时序的生殖活动。

branches.en: COPIES OF THINGS: an art reproduction and a photocopied document, both openly second-hand.
branches.cn: 物品的复制：艺术复制品与复印文件，都公开地是二手之物。

branches.en: SYSTEMS REPRODUCING THEMSELVES: capital and labour renewed, and social divisions passed on.
branches.cn: 体系自我延续：资本与劳动力的更新，以及社会分层的传递。

branches.en: AN EXPERIENCE BROUGHT BACK: a recorded scene that a listener can enter again.
branches.cn: 体验的再现：被记录的场面，让听者得以再次进入。

branches.en: FIDELITY AS A STANDARD: the measured quality of sound or colour returned.
branches.cn: 作为标准的还原度：声音或色彩被送回时的可测质量。

intro.en: Reproduction is re- plus production. The family includes the verb reproduce and the adjectives reproductive and reproducible, with -tion, -ive, and -ible doing different work.
intro.cn: reproduction 是 re- 加 production。词族包括动词 reproduce 以及形容词 reproductive 与 reproducible，其中 -tion、-ive、-ible 各司其职。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is ducere, with producere and productio above it. The prefix re- is Latin and the -tion suffix reaches English through French.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词基是 ducere，其上是 producere 与 productio。前缀 re- 来自拉丁语，后缀 -tion 经法语进入英语。

items.example: The same root appears in duct, reduce, and conduct.
items.exampleCN: 同一词根出现在 duct（管道）、reduce（减少）、conduct（引导）等词中。

items.example: The Latin verb could describe a tree putting out new growth.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁动词可以描述树木长出新枝。

items.structure: Latin producere through English verb formation
items.meaning: to make, grow, or bring into being
items.example: The region produces most of the country's rice.
items.exampleCN: 该国大部分稻米产自这个地区。

items.meaning: the act of making goods or works
items.example: Steel production fell for a second year.
items.exampleCN: 钢产量连续第二年下降。

items.meaning: to breed, or to make a copy
items.exampleCN: 有些蜥蜴无需雄性即可繁殖。

items.meaning: the process or result of producing again
items.example: The archive keeps a reproduction of every fragile map.
items.exampleCN: 档案馆为每张易损地图保存一份复制品。

items.example: The frog's reproductive cycle depends on seasonal rain.
items.exampleCN: 这种蛙的生殖周期取决于季节性降雨。

items.meaning: able to be made again or copied
items.example: A reproducible result is the minimum standard in experimental science.
items.exampleCN: 可重现的结果是实验科学的最低标准。

items.example: The journal now asks authors for a reproducibility statement.
items.exampleCN: 该期刊现在要求作者提交可复现性声明。

definition_zh: 爬行动物；爬虫；（贬义）卑劣的人
definition_en: a cold-blooded vertebrate with scales that lays eggs on land, such as a snake, lizard or turtle, or a contemptible person
core_image: 一只蜥蜴腹部几乎贴地，四肢向两侧撑开，在热石上缓缓前行
scene: 沙漠的岩石上，一只蜥蜴腹部贴地，四肢向两侧撑开，慢慢向前爬。 The reptile moved low over the hot stone, its belly almost touching the surface.
sceneCN: 这里 reptile 指「爬行动物」（第 1 个义项：体表有鳞、在陆上产卵的变温脊椎动物）；句意为这只爬行动物贴着滚烫的石头低身前行，腹部几乎碰到地面。

derivatives.zh: 爬行动物的；像爬行动物的

senses.title: A scaly, cold-blooded vertebrate
senses.titleCN: 体表有鳞的变温脊椎动物
senses.definition: a vertebrate with dry scaly skin that regulates its body temperature by behaviour and usually lays eggs on land
senses.definitionCN: 皮肤干燥有鳞、靠行为调节体温、通常在陆上产卵的脊椎动物
senses.example: The reptile moved low over the hot stone.
senses.exampleCN: 这只爬行动物贴着热石低身前行。
senses.why: The Latin name means 'creeping thing', and the defining traits are scales and a body that must warm itself in the sun.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁原名意为「爬行的东西」，其标志特征是鳞片与必须靠晒太阳取暖的身体。

senses.title: The class Reptilia as a whole
senses.definition: the reptiles collectively, a vertebrate class that in modern classification includes birds
senses.definitionCN: 所有爬行动物的集合，现代分类中这一纲还包括鸟类
senses.example: Reptiles occupy every continent except Antarctica.
senses.exampleCN: 除南极洲外，每个大陆都有爬行动物。
senses.why: Because the class is a formal unit, the plural often names a category rather than individual animals.
senses.whyCN: 因为这是一个正式分类单元，复数常指范畴而不是个体动物。

senses.title: A reptile kept as a pet
senses.titleCN: 作为宠物饲养的爬行动物
senses.definition: a snake, lizard or turtle kept in a terrarium and sold through the pet trade
senses.definitionCN: 养在饲养箱中、经宠物贸易出售的蛇、蜥蜴或龟
senses.example: The shop sells reptile supplies as well as the animals.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店既卖爬行动物，也卖饲养用品。
senses.why: The pet trade uses the class name as a market category, so reptile becomes a product label.
senses.whyCN: 宠物贸易把纲名当作市场类别，于是 reptile 成了产品标签。

senses.title: A venomous reptile
senses.definition: a reptile that injects venom through fangs or a sting, such as a viper
senses.definitionCN: 通过毒牙或毒刺注入毒液的爬行动物，如蝰蛇
senses.example: Antivenom is made from the venom of a reptile.
senses.exampleCN: 抗蛇毒血清由某种爬行动物的毒液制成。
senses.why: Medical writing uses the class name because the bite may come from a snake, a lizard or a turtle.
senses.whyCN: 医学文献用纲名，因为咬伤可能来自蛇、蜥蜴或龟。

senses.title: A fossil reptile
senses.definition: ancient reptile remains, including dinosaurs in traditional usage
senses.definitionCN: 古代爬行动物遗骸，传统用法中也包括恐龙
senses.example: The fossil reptile had a sail-like crest on its back.
senses.exampleCN: 这只爬行动物化石背部有帆状脊冠。
senses.why: Palaeontology long treated dinosaurs as reptiles, and the word still carries that history even though birds are their descendants.
senses.whyCN: 古生物学长期把恐龙当作爬行动物，这个词仍带着这段历史，尽管鸟类是恐龙的后代。

senses.title: The reptile house in a zoo
senses.definition: a heated building where snakes and other reptiles are displayed to the public
senses.definitionCN: 向公众展示蛇类等爬行动物、保持加热的馆舍
senses.example: The children queued for the reptile house.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们排队等着进爬行动物馆。
senses.why: Zoos needed a short exhibit label, and the class name became a building name.
senses.whyCN: 动物园需要简短的展区名称，纲名于是成了建筑名。

senses.title: A contemptible person
senses.definition: an insulting term for someone seen as low, treacherous or grovelling
senses.definitionCN: 蔑称，指低劣、阴险或谄媚的人
senses.example: The old pamphlet called the informer a reptile.
senses.exampleCN: 那本旧小册子把告密者称为卑劣之徒。
senses.why: The insult draws on the animal's belly-down movement and its reputation for coldness, turning 'creeping' into moral contempt.
senses.whyCN: 这个骂法利用了动物贴地爬行的姿态与「冷血」的名声，把「爬」转成道德上的轻蔑。

senses.title: Reptile leather
senses.definition: the skin of a snake, crocodile or other reptile used for bags, belts and shoes
senses.definitionCN: 用于包、带、鞋的蛇、鳄等爬行动物皮革
senses.example: The belt was made of reptile skin.
senses.exampleCN: 这条腰带是爬行动物皮革做的。
senses.why: The material trade names the product by its source class, so reptile also functions as an attributive noun.
senses.whyCN: 材料行业按来源类群给产品命名，因此 reptile 也作定语名词使用。

intro.en: Reptile goes back to Latin repere 'to creep' through the adjective reptilis; the name describes how the animal moves, not how it is built. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: reptile 经形容词 reptilis 上溯到拉丁 repere「爬行」；这个名字描述的是行动方式，而非身体构造。年代均为约数。

items.en: Repere meant 'to creep, crawl'. Its deeper origin is not settled, so any Indo-European root proposed for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: repere 意为「爬行、匍匐」。其更深来源没有定论，凡为它提出的印欧词根都属重构。

items.en: Reptilis meant 'creeping, crawling', an adjective formed from the verb and used of animals that move close to the ground.
items.cn: reptilis 意为「爬行的、匍匐的」，由动词构成的形容词，用于贴地移动的动物。

items.en: English reptile is recorded from the late fourteenth century, first for creeping animals in general and later for the scaly vertebrate class.
items.cn: 英语 reptile 自 14 世纪后期有记录，最初泛指爬行动物，后来才专指有鳞的脊椎动物纲。

items.en: Eighteenth-century zoology fixed Reptilia as a class, separating snakes, lizards and turtles from amphibians and insects.
items.cn: 18 世纪动物学把 Reptilia 固定为一个纲，把蛇、蜥蜴、龟与两栖动物及昆虫分开。

items.en: From the eighteenth century 'reptile' was used as an insult for a low or grovelling person, drawing on the belly-down image.
items.cn: 从 18 世纪起，reptile 被用作侮辱语，指低劣或谄媚的人，取「贴地爬行」的形象。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper root): the Latin stages are clear, but the pre-Latin origin of repere is unsettled and the exact first English citation is approximate.
items.cn: 来源不确定（更深词根）：拉丁阶段清楚，但 repere 的拉丁语之前来源没有定论，英语确切首见书证也只是约数。

note.en: Group one holds forms from the same reptile stock; group two holds animal names and adjectives that are often misplaced around reptiles.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 reptile 词族的形式；第二组是常被误置于爬行动物语境中的动物名与形容词。

entries.definition: Of or like reptiles; as a noun in science fiction it also means a reptile-like being.
entries.definitionCN: 爬行动物的或像爬行动物的；在科幻作品中作名词还指似爬行类的人形生物。

entries.definition: The formal Latin class name; Reptilia is the whole class, a reptile is one member.
entries.definitionCN: 正式拉丁纲名；Reptilia 是整个纲，reptile 是一个成员。

entries.definition: A botanical adjective meaning creeping along the ground; it shares the Latin verb but describes plants.
entries.definitionCN: 植物学形容词，意为贴地匍匐；它同出拉丁动词，却描述植物。

entries.definition: Built with -oid 'like', it describes a reptile-like form without claiming it belongs to the class.
entries.definitionCN: 由 -oid「像」构成，描述似爬行动物的形态，并不表示它属于该纲。

entries.definition: A vertebrate that usually breeds in water and has moist skin; it is not a reptile, though both are cold-blooded.
entries.definitionCN: 通常在水中繁殖、皮肤潮湿的脊椎动物；它不是爬行动物，尽管两者都是变温动物。

entries.definition: A small reptile with four legs and a long tail; it is one kind of reptile, not a synonym.
entries.definitionCN: 有四足和长尾的小型爬行动物；它是爬行动物的一种，并非同义词。

entries.definition: A limbless reptile; again a member of the class rather than a general term.
entries.definitionCN: 无肢的爬行动物；同样是纲内成员，而不是泛称。

entries.definition: An animal that relies on external heat; reptiles are ectotherms, but so are many fish and invertebrates.
entries.definitionCN: 依赖外部热量的动物；爬行动物是变温动物，但许多鱼与无脊椎动物也是。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Reptile comes from 'to creep': the animal that moves with its belly near the ground.
normal.cn: reptile 来自「爬行」：腹部贴近地面移动的动物。

normal.en: Snakes, lizards, turtles and crocodiles are reptiles; frogs are amphibians.
normal.cn: 蛇、蜥蜴、龟、鳄是爬行动物；蛙是两栖动物。

normal.en: Reptilia is the class; reptile is one member; reptilian is the adjective.
normal.cn: Reptilia 是纲；reptile 是成员；reptilian 是形容词。

normal.en: Reptile house is the fixed zoo label for the heated exhibit building.
normal.cn: reptile house 是动物园里指加热展馆的固定说法。

normal.en: The insult 'reptile' plays on the same belly-down image, not on the biology.
normal.cn: 骂人的 reptile 用的是同一个「贴地」形象，与生物学无关。

abstract.en: Picture a body that must borrow its warmth from a stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一具必须向石头借温暖的身体。

abstract.en: Picture a creature that hears the ground through its jaw.
abstract.cn: 想象一个通过下颌听见大地的生物。

abstract.en: Picture an insult that crawls: the same word for an animal and for a person you despise.
abstract.cn: 想象一句会爬的骂人话：同一个词既指动物，也指你鄙视的人。

examples.en: Reptiles regulate their temperature by moving between sun and shade.
examples.cn: 爬行动物通过在阳光与阴影间移动来调节体温。

examples.en: The reptile house keeps the snakes warm through the winter.
examples.cn: 爬行动物馆让蛇整个冬天都保持温暖。

examples.en: The treaty restricts trade in reptile skins.
examples.cn: 该条约限制爬行动物皮革贸易。

dict_mnemonic.text: reptile 读起来像「瑞普泰尔」——贴地爬（rept-）的动物；记「肚皮贴地的都是爬行动物」

root: 拉丁 repere「爬行」→ reptilis「爬行的」→ 英语 reptile；repere 的更深词源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow a creeping animal from the desert floor to the pet shop, the antivenom lab, the fossil bed, the zoo building, the leather trade and finally to an insult for a person.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项让一种爬行动物从沙漠地面走到宠物店、抗毒血清实验室、化石层、动物园展馆、皮革贸易，最后变成对人的骂语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lizard moving belly-down across hot stone, legs splayed to the sides.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只蜥蜴腹部贴地、四肢向两侧张开，在热石上移动。

branches.en: ANIMAL AND CLASS: one creeping vertebrate, or the whole scaly class.
branches.cn: 动物与纲：一只爬行的脊椎动物，或整个有鳞的纲。

branches.en: HUMAN USE: a terrarium pet and a medical hazard.
branches.cn: 人的利用：既是被饲养的宠物，也是医学上的危险。

branches.en: MATERIAL TRACES: fossil bones and traded skins both carry the class name.
branches.cn: 物质痕迹：化石骨骼与交易皮革都带着纲名。

branches.en: DISPLAY: the heated zoo building is named after its inhabitants.
branches.cn: 展示：加热的动物园建筑以住户命名。

branches.en: THE INSULT: belly-down movement becomes moral lowliness.
branches.cn: 骂语：贴地而行变成了道德上的低劣。

intro.en: Reptile is a Latin verb turned adjective turned English noun; the stem also gives reptilian and the class name Reptilia.
intro.cn: reptile 是拉丁动词变形容词、再变英语名词的结果；同一词干还给出 reptilian 与纲名 Reptilia。

latinIntro.en: Latin repere 'to creep' yields reptilis and reptilium; English draws reptile, reptilian and reptant from the same stock.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 repere「爬行」衍生 reptilis 与 reptilium；英语的 reptile、reptilian、reptant 都取自这一词族。

items.example: The stem supplies the crawling image.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干提供「爬行」的形象。
reptilis 意为会爬行的。

items.example: The reptile basked on the rock.
items.exampleCN: 这只爬行动物在岩石上晒太阳。

items.example: Reptiles need warmth to digest food.
items.exampleCN: 爬行动物需要温暖才能消化食物。

items.example: Reptilian means belonging to the reptiles.
items.exampleCN: reptilian 意为属于爬行动物的。

items.meaningCN: 爬行动物的；像爬行动物的
items.exampleCN: 那只爬行动物般的眼睛从不眨。

items.meaning: creeping, as of a plant stem
items.example: The reptant stem rooted at each node.
items.exampleCN: 匍匐茎在每个节处生根。
爬行纲包括蛇与龟。

definition_zh: 共和主义者；共和国的；共和党的
definition_en: a person who supports government by elected representatives, or something relating to a republic
core_image: 胸前别着一枚没有王冠的徽章，主张权力来自公民
scene: 集会上，一位共和主义者举着标语，主张废除君主、由选举产生元首。The republican argued for an elected head of state.
sceneCN: 这里 republican 是「共和主义者」（第 1 个义项：支持共和政体的人）；句意：这位共和主义者主张由选举产生国家元首。

senses.title: A supporter of republican government
senses.definition: a person who believes that a country should be governed by elected representatives rather than a king
senses.definitionCN: 主张国家应由民选代表而不是国王治理的人
senses.example: The republican spoke against the power of the crown.
senses.exampleCN: 这位共和主义者发言反对王权。
senses.why: The ending -an marks a person connected with a republic, so the basic sense is the supporter of that system.
senses.whyCN: 词尾 -an 标记与共和国相关的人，所以基本义是这种制度的支持者。

senses.title: Relating to a republic
senses.definition: describing something connected with a republic or its principles
senses.definitionCN: 描述与共和国或其原则相关的事物
senses.example: The country adopted a republican constitution.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家通过了共和国宪法。
senses.why: The same -an ending also forms an adjective, which simply describes what belongs to a republic.
senses.whyCN: 同一个 -an 词尾也能构成形容词，直接描述属于共和国的事物。

senses.title: A member of a republican party
senses.definition: a member or supporter of a political party that calls itself Republican
senses.definitionCN: 某个自称共和党的政党的成员或支持者
senses.example: The Republican won the state by a narrow margin.
senses.exampleCN: 这名共和党人以微弱优势赢下了该州。
senses.why: Political parties borrow the word for their names, so the adjective becomes a party label.
