senses.whyCN: 政党借用这个词作为名称，于是形容词又变成党派标签。

intro.en: Republican is republic plus the ending -an, which marks a person or an adjective connected with the base word.
intro.cn: republican 是 republic 加词尾 -an，表示与基础词相关的人或形容词。

items.en: The base is res publica, the public thing, a phrase for the shared state.
items.cn: 基础是 res publica（公共之事），指共享的国家。

items.en: Old French republique turns the phrase into the noun republic.
items.cn: 古法语 republique 把这一短语变成名词 republic。

items.en: Middle English republic names a state without a monarch.
items.cn: 中古英语 republic 指不设君主的国家。

items.en: Republican appears for a supporter of that form of government.
items.cn: republican 出现，指这种政体的支持者。

items.en: American and French politics turn the word into a party label.
items.cn: 美国和法国政治把这个词变成党派标签。

items.en: Modern English uses republican for both the believer and the adjective.
items.cn: 现代英语中，republican 既指信奉者，也作形容词。

note.en: Republican is the person-and-adjective member of the republic family, and it sits near words for democratic and constitutional politics.
note.cn: republican 是 republic 词族中表示人或形容词的成员，与民主、宪政政治词汇相邻。

entries.definition: a state governed by elected representatives
belief in republican government
a supporter of government by the people
a person who supports government limited by a constitution
a person opposed to rule by a king or queen

normalIntro.en: Republican is republic plus -an, so the ending tells you it is either a person of that belief or an adjective of that system.
normalIntro.cn: republican 是 republic 加 -an，词尾告诉你它要么指持这种信念的人，要么是这种制度的形容词。

normal.en: Republic plus -an: a person who stands for the public thing.
normal.cn: republic 加 -an：为公共之事站台的人。

normal.en: The capital R version is a party name in American politics.
normal.cn: 大写 R 的版本是美国政治中的党派名称。

normal.en: Republican government is government without a monarch.
normal.cn: republican government 就是不设君主的政府。

normal.en: Compare republic and republicanism: the country and the belief.
normal.cn: 对比 republic 与 republicanism：国家与信念。

normal.en: The ending -an works like the -an in American, naming a person or an adjective.
normal.cn: 词尾 -an 就像 American 中的 -an，表示人或形容词。

abstract.en: Picture a badge with no crown on it, worn on a plain jacket.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚没有王冠的徽章，别在朴素的夹克上。

abstract.en: Imagine a speaker at a rally pointing at a written constitution.
abstract.cn: 想象集会上的演讲者指着成文宪法。

abstract.en: Think of a ballot box standing where a throne used to be.
abstract.cn: 想象投票箱立在原来放王座的地方。

examples.en: The republican rejected the idea of a hereditary ruler.
examples.cn: 这位共和主义者拒绝世袭统治者的观念。

examples.en: The country wrote a republican constitution after the war.
examples.cn: 战后这个国家制定了共和国宪法。

examples.en: The Republican candidate visited three states in one day.
examples.cn: 这名共和党候选人一天走访了三个州。

dict_mnemonic.text: republic（共和国）+ -an（人／形容词词尾）＝共和主义者或共和国的；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: republic（共和国，源自拉丁语 res publica「公共之事」）+ 词尾 -an，表示与共和国相关的人或性质。

sensesIntro.en: The believer comes first, then the adjective for the system, then the party member who borrows the name.
sensesIntro.cn: 先信奉这种制度的人，再是描述制度的形容词，最后是借用这个名称的政党成员。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a citizen loyal to the public thing rather than to a crown.
core.cn: 核心意象：忠于公共之事、而非王冠的公民。

branches.en: The supporter of elected government is the central personal sense.
branches.cn: 支持民选政府的人，是核心的「人」的义项。

branches.en: The adjective describes whatever belongs to a republic.
branches.cn: 形容词描述属于共和国的一切。

branches.en: A party member carries the name into electoral politics.
branches.cn: 政党成员把这个名称带入选举政治。

branches.en: The believer and the adjective share the same loyalty to a republic.
branches.cn: 信奉者与形容词共享对共和国的忠诚。

branches.en: The system adjective becomes a party label through political use.
branches.cn: 制度形容词经政治使用变成党派标签。

intro.en: Republican is a transparent English formation from republic plus the ending -an.
intro.cn: republican 是 republic 加词尾 -an 构成的、构词透明的英语词。

latinIntro.en: The base republic goes back to res publica, the public thing, and -an marks a person or adjective connected with it.
latinIntro.cn: 基础词 republic 可上溯到 res publica（公共之事），-an 标记与之相关的人或形容词。

items.example: Republic is the base of republican.
items.exampleCN: republic 是 republican 的基础词。

items.meaning: relating to or a person of
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -an 构成 republican。
republican 由 republic 与 -an 合成。
republicans 在 republican 后加 -s。
republicanism 在 republican 后加 -ism。
词尾 -ism 构成 republicanism。

items.example: Res publica is the distant source of republic.
items.exampleCN: res publica 是 republic 的远源。

items.example: Publica is the adjective inside res publica.
items.exampleCN: publica 是 res publica 中的形容词。

definition_en: the opinion that people have about someone or something, based on past behaviour or quality
core_image: 街坊邻居提起这个名字时形成的共同评价，像一块慢慢磨亮的招牌
scene: 这家小面馆从不打广告，靠街坊口口相传，几十年攒下了好名声。The little restaurant earned its reputation one bowl at a time.
sceneCN: 这里 reputation 是「名声；声誉」（第 1 个义项：人们根据过往表现形成的评价）；句意：这家小馆一碗一碗地赢得好名声。

senses.title: The opinion people have
senses.definition: the general opinion that people have about a person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 人们普遍持有的对某人或某物的看法
senses.example: The school has a reputation for strict teaching.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校以教学严格著称。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to think over, so a reputation is the opinion formed after repeated consideration.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「反复思量」，所以名声是经过反复考虑后形成的看法。

senses.title: A good name
senses.definition: the respect and trust that come from being known to behave well
senses.definitionCN: 因表现良好而获得的尊重与信任
senses.example: He built his reputation on honest dealing.
senses.exampleCN: 他以诚信经营建立了声誉。
senses.why: Because people want a good opinion rather than a bad one, the word often carries the positive sense of a good name.
senses.whyCN: 因为人们想要好评价而不是坏评价，这个词常带有「好名声」的正面含义。

senses.title: The state of being known
senses.definition: the state of being well known by many people
senses.definitionCN: 被许多人熟知的状态
senses.example: Her reputation spread far beyond the city.
senses.exampleCN: 她的名声传到了城市之外很远的地方。
senses.why: A widely shared opinion naturally becomes fame, so being known is a further extension of the same idea.
senses.whyCN: 被广泛共享的看法自然成为名望，所以「被熟知」是同一想法的进一步延伸。

intro.en: Reputation comes from Latin reputatio, from reputare, to think over, built from re- and putare, to consider.
intro.cn: reputation 来自拉丁语 reputatio，源自动词 reputare（反复思量），由 re- 与 putare（思考、估算）构成。

items.en: Putare means to think, reckon, or judge, and it also gives us compute.
items.cn: putare 意为思考、估算或判断，也是 compute 的来源。

items.en: Reputare adds re-, over again, and means to consider something repeatedly.
items.cn: reputare 加上 re-（反复），意为反复考虑某事。

items.en: Reputatio names the judging and the standing that results from it.
items.cn: reputatio 指评判行为以及由此形成的地位。

items.en: Old French reputation keeps the sense of public estimation.
items.cn: 古法语 reputation 保留「公众评价」的意思。

items.en: Middle English reputation names what people generally think of a person.
items.cn: 中古英语 reputation 指人们对某人的普遍看法。

items.en: Modern English uses it for both good standing and simple fame.
items.cn: 现代英语中，它既指良好声誉，也指单纯的知名度。

note.en: Reputation belongs to a Latin thinking-and-judging family, and it sits close to words for fame and standing.
note.cn: reputation 属于拉丁语「思考与评判」词族，与名望和地位的词相邻。

entries.definition: the opinion generally held about someone
having a good reputation
believed by many people to be something
the state of being known by many people
the reputation a person or company has
a person's rank or status in a group
respect gained through success or importance

normalIntro.en: Reputation contains repute, from Latin putare, to think, so the word is literally what people have thought about you over and over.
normalIntro.cn: reputation 含有 repute，源自拉丁语 putare（思考），所以这个词字面上就是「人们反复思量后对你的看法」。

normal.en: Re- means again, and putare means think: think about someone again and again, and a reputation forms.
normal.cn: re- 表示反复，putare 表示思考：反复想一个人，就形成名声。

normal.en: Have a reputation for is the pattern that follows the word most often.
normal.cn: have a reputation for 是这个词最常见的搭配模式。

normal.en: Build a reputation suggests it takes time and repeated acts.
normal.cn: build a reputation 暗示名声需要时间和反复行动。

normal.en: Damage a reputation is much faster than building one.
normal.cn: damage a reputation 比建立名声快得多。

normal.en: Compare reputable: the adjective means having a good reputation.
normal.cn: 对比 reputable：形容词意为「有好名声的」。

abstract.en: Picture a shop sign polished brighter by every satisfied customer.
abstract.cn: 想象每位满意的顾客都把店招擦得更亮一点。

abstract.en: Imagine neighbours repeating the same story about a person until it sticks.
abstract.cn: 想象邻居反复讲同一个人的故事，直到它固定下来。

abstract.en: Think of a name written in many notebooks across a town.
abstract.cn: 想象一个名字被写进全城许多本笔记本。

examples.en: The company has a reputation for paying on time.
examples.cn: 这家公司以按时付款著称。

examples.en: One scandal can ruin a lifetime's reputation.
examples.cn: 一场丑闻可能毁掉一生的声誉。

examples.en: She arrived with a reputation as a tough negotiator.
examples.cn: 她来时已以强硬谈判者闻名。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（反复）+ put（思考）＝人们反复思量后形成的看法，即名声；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（反复）+ putare（思考、判断）→ reputare（反复思量）→ reputatio（评价、声望）→ 古法语 reputation → 中古英语 reputation。

sensesIntro.en: An opinion formed by repeated thought comes first, then the good version people want, and finally the wide fame that spreads it.
sensesIntro.cn: 先有反复思考形成的评价，再是人们想要的正面版本，最后是把它传播开来的广泛名望。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a name polished by what people repeatedly say and think about it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个名字被人们反复谈论和思量，渐渐磨亮。

branches.en: The general opinion is the neutral core sense.
branches.cn: 普遍看法，是中性的核心义项。

branches.en: The opinion becomes a good name when it is positive.
branches.cn: 当评价是正面的，就成为好名声。

branches.en: A widely held opinion spreads into fame and public recognition.
branches.cn: 被广泛持有的看法扩散为名望与公众认可。

branches.en: Neutral opinion and good name differ only in direction.
branches.cn: 中性评价与好名声只在方向上不同。

branches.en: Good standing and wide fame both grow from what others say.
branches.cn: 良好声誉与广泛名望都从他人的言谈中生长出来。

intro.en: Reputation is a Latin noun formed on reputare, with English relatives built from the repute stem.
intro.cn: reputation 是在拉丁动词 reputare 基础上构成的名词，其英语亲属词由 repute 词干派生。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means over again, and putare means to think or judge, so reputare is to think something over.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示反复，putare 表示思考或判断，所以 reputare 就是「反复思量」。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 reputare 与 reputation 开头。

items.example: Putare is the root of reputation and compute.
items.exampleCN: putare 是 reputation 与 compute 的词根。
reputare 由 re- 与 putare 合成。

items.example: Reputatio is the Latin noun behind reputation.
items.exampleCN: reputatio 是 reputation 背后的拉丁名词。

items.example: Reputation keeps the Latin noun shape.
items.exampleCN: reputation 保留了拉丁名词形态。

items.example: Reputable adds -able to the repute stem.
items.exampleCN: reputable 在 repute 词干后加 -able。

items.example: Reputed adds -ed to the repute stem.
items.exampleCN: reputed 在 repute 词干后加 -ed。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ation 构成 reputation。
词尾 -able 构成 reputable。

definition_en: the act of politely asking for something, or the thing that is asked for
core_image: 一个人轻轻敲门，把写着自己需要的纸条递进去，等待对方点头
scene: 客人把需要更多毛巾的请求写在卡片上，前台很快送来了。Her request for an extra towel was met within minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 request 是「请求」（第 1 个义项：礼貌地开口要求某事）；句意：她要一条额外毛巾的请求几分钟内就得到了满足。

senses.title: The act of asking politely
senses.definition: the act of asking for something in a polite or formal way
senses.definitionCN: 以礼貌或正式方式提出要求的行为
senses.example: She made a request for more time.
senses.exampleCN: 她请求多给一些时间。
senses.why: The word comes from a verb meaning to seek again, so the core sense is the act of asking.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自意为「再次寻求」的动词，所以核心义是「开口要求」这个动作。

senses.title: The thing asked for
senses.definition: the thing that someone asks for
senses.definitionCN: 某人要求得到的东西
senses.example: His request was simple: a quiet room.
senses.exampleCN: 他的请求很简单：一间安静的房间。
senses.why: The act of asking easily becomes the name of what is asked for.
senses.whyCN: 「请求」这个动作很容易转指「被请求的东西」。

senses.title: To ask formally
senses.definition: to ask for something in a polite or official way
senses.definitionCN: 以礼貌或正式的方式要求某事
senses.example: Guests are requested to keep their voices low.
senses.exampleCN: 请客人保持低声。
senses.why: The verb simply puts the noun's action into grammatical form, with the same polite or official tone.
senses.whyCN: 动词只是把名词所指的动作变成语法形式，礼貌或正式的语气保持不变。

intro.en: Request comes through Old French requeste from Latin requirere, to seek again, from re- and quaerere, to seek.
intro.cn: request 经古法语 requeste 来自拉丁语 requirere（再次寻求），由 re- 与 quaerere（寻求）构成。

items.en: Quaerere means to seek, ask, or inquire, and it also gives us question.
items.cn: quaerere 意为寻求、询问或探问，也是 question 的来源。

items.en: Requirere adds re- and means to seek again or ask for something needed.
items.cn: requirere 加上 re-，意为再次寻求或索取所需之物。

items.en: The noun requesta names a formal asking or petition.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语名词 requesta 指正式的请求或请愿。

items.en: Old French requeste carries the noun into English with a polite tone.
items.cn: 古法语 requeste 把这个名词带入英语，并带有礼貌语气。

items.en: Middle English request covers both the asking and the thing asked for.
items.cn: 中古英语 request 既指请求动作，也指所请求之物。

items.en: Modern English uses request as both noun and verb in formal settings.
items.cn: 现代英语中，request 在正式场合兼作名词和动词。

note.en: Request belongs to the seek-and-ask family, and it is close to words for appeals, applications, and demands.
note.cn: request 属于「寻求与询问」词族，与呼吁、申请和要求类词相邻。

entries.definition: to need or demand something
something that is needed or demanded
a person who makes a request
an urgent request for help or support
a formal written request signed by many people
a formal request for a job or place
a strong request that is hard to refuse

normalIntro.en: Request contains quest, the seeking root of question, so the memory picture is going out to seek something and asking politely for it.
normalIntro.cn: request 含有 quest 这个「寻求」词根，也见于 question，记忆画面是出去寻求并礼貌地开口。

normal.en: Re- means again, and quest means seek: seek again by asking.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，quest 表示寻求：通过开口再次寻求。

normal.en: Make a request is the standard phrase for the act.
normal.cn: make a request 是表示这个动作的标准搭配。

normal.en: On request means it will be given as soon as someone asks.
normal.cn: on request 意为「一经请求就提供」。

normal.en: At the request of marks who asked for it.
normal.cn: at the request of 标出是谁提出的请求。

normal.en: Compare require: to require is stronger and means need or demand.
normal.cn: 对比 require：语气更强，意为需要或要求。

abstract.en: Picture a note slipped under a hotel room door asking for towels.
abstract.cn: 想象一张纸条从酒店房门下塞进去，要求毛巾。

abstract.en: Imagine a raised hand in a quiet room waiting to be called on.
abstract.cn: 想象安静的房间里举起一只手，等待被点到。

abstract.en: Think of a form filled out and handed across a counter.
abstract.cn: 想象填好的表格被递过柜台。

examples.en: The manager granted her request for leave.
examples.cn: 经理批准了她的休假请求。

examples.en: All requests must be sent in writing.
examples.cn: 所有请求都必须以书面形式提交。

examples.en: Visitors are requested to sign in at the desk.
examples.cn: 请访客在前台登记。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（再次）+ quest（寻求）＝再次开口寻求，即请求；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ quaerere（寻求、询问）→ requirere（再次寻求）→ 中世纪拉丁语 requesta → 古法语 requeste → 中古英语 request。

sensesIntro.en: The polite act of asking comes first, then the thing asked for, and the verb reuses the same shape for formal asking.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是礼貌开口的动作，再是被请求之物，动词则沿用同一形态表示正式请求。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a polite note passed to someone who can grant what it asks.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张礼貌的纸条递给有能力答应请求的人。

branches.en: The act of asking is the central noun sense.
branches.cn: 开口请求的动作，是核心名词义项。

branches.en: The content of the asking becomes the thing requested.
branches.cn: 询问的内容成为「被请求之物」。

branches.en: The verb repeats the same act in a formal setting.
branches.cn: 动词在正式场合重复同一个动作。

branches.en: Act and object are two sides of one polite exchange.
branches.cn: 动作与对象是一次礼貌往来中的两面。

branches.en: Noun and verb differ only in grammar, not in the asking.
branches.cn: 名词与动词只在语法上不同，请求本身相同。

intro.en: Request is a French-shaped noun built on a Latin prefix and the seeking root quaerere.
intro.cn: request 是法语形态的名词，建立在拉丁前缀与「寻求」词根 quaerere 之上。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, and quaerere means to seek or ask, so requirere is to seek again.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示再次，quaerere 表示寻求或询问，所以 requirere 就是「再次寻求」。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 request 与 require 开头。

items.example: Quaerere is the root of request and question.
items.exampleCN: quaerere 是 request 与 question 的词根。

items.example: Requirere supplies the stem of request.
items.exampleCN: requirere 提供 request 的词干。
requesta 在法语中变成 requeste。
request 经法语进入英语。
requester 在 request 后加 -er。
requested 在 request 后加 -ed。
词尾 -er 构成 requester。

definition_en: to need something, or to demand it as a rule or condition
core_image: 一张任务清单上，某些条件被画了红圈，缺一项就无法开工
scene: 这份工作需要耐心和稳定的手，体检合格是硬性条件。The job requires patience and careful hands.
sceneCN: 这里 require 是「需要」（第 1 个义项：某事成功所不可缺少的条件）；句意：这份工作需要耐心和一双稳当的手。

senses.title: To need something
senses.definition: to need something in order to happen or succeed
senses.definitionCN: 为了发生或成功而不可缺少某物
senses.example: This plant requires plenty of sunlight.
senses.exampleCN: 这种植物需要充足的阳光。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to seek again, and a need is something the situation keeps seeking.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「再次寻求」，而「需要」正是情境不断寻求的东西。

senses.title: To demand by rule
senses.definition: to officially demand something as a rule or condition
senses.definitionCN: 以规则或条件的形式正式要求某事
senses.example: The law requires drivers to carry a licence.
senses.exampleCN: 法律要求司机携带驾照。
senses.why: An authority can turn a need into an obligation, which gives the word its demanding sense.
senses.whyCN: 权威可以把「需要」变成义务，于是这个词带上了强制要求的意味。

senses.title: To make necessary
senses.definition: to make something necessary as a result or consequence
senses.definitionCN: 作为结果或后果使某事成为必要
senses.example: The repair will require closing the road.
senses.exampleCN: 这次维修将需要封闭道路。
senses.why: If a condition cannot be met without an action, the condition effectively requires the action.
senses.whyCN: 如果缺少某个行动就无法满足条件，这个条件实际上就「要求」了该行动。

intro.en: Require comes from Latin requirere, to seek again, built from re- and quaerere, to seek.
intro.cn: require 来自拉丁语 requirere（再次寻求），由 re- 与 quaerere（寻求）构成。

items.en: Quaerere means to seek, ask, or inquire.
items.cn: quaerere 意为寻求、询问或探问。

items.en: Requirere adds re- and means to look for something, especially something missing.
items.cn: requirere 加上 re-，意为寻找某物，尤指缺失之物。

items.en: The verb develops the sense of needing what is sought.
items.cn: 该动词发展出「需要所寻之物」的意思。

items.en: Old French requerre carries the demand sense into English.
items.cn: 古法语 requerre 把「要求」义带入英语。

items.en: Middle English require covers need, demand, and obligation.
items.cn: 中古英语 require 涵盖需要、要求和义务。

items.en: Modern English uses it for rules, conditions, and logical consequences.
items.cn: 现代英语用它表示规则、条件和逻辑后果。

note.en: Require shares its seeking root with request, and its family includes the noun for a condition and the word for something indispensable.
note.cn: require 与 request 共享「寻求」词根，其词族包括表示条件的名词和表示不可或缺之物的词。

entries.definition: something that is needed or demanded
necessary for a particular purpose
an official demand for supplies or property
to have to have something in order to manage
to ask for something firmly or officially
to make something necessary
to need or deserve a particular action

normalIntro.en: Require and request share the quest root, but require is stronger: it names a need that must be met.
normalIntro.cn: require 与 request 共享 quest 词根，但 require 语气更强：它指向必须被满足的需要。

normal.en: Re- means again, and quire sounds like quest: keep seeking until the need is met.
normal.cn: re- 表示再次，quire 听起来像 quest：一直寻求，直到需要被满足。

normal.en: Require attention means attention is not optional.
normal.cn: require attention 意为关注不是可选项。

normal.en: Require sb to do is the pattern for rules that force an action.
normal.cn: require sb to do 是强制行动的规则句型。

normal.en: As required is the phrase for doing something when a rule says so.
normal.cn: as required 意为「按规则要求去做」。

normal.en: Compare request and require: asking politely versus demanding by need or rule.
normal.cn: 对比 request 与 require：礼貌询问与因需要或规则而要求。

abstract.en: Picture a checklist with red circles around the items that cannot be skipped.
abstract.cn: 想象清单上几个不能跳过的项目被红笔圈出。

abstract.en: Imagine a door that will not open until three conditions are met.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门，必须满足三个条件才会打开。

abstract.en: Think of a recipe that fails if one ingredient is missing.
abstract.cn: 想象一份食谱，少一样材料就会失败。

examples.en: The job requires strong communication skills.
examples.cn: 这份工作需要很强的沟通能力。

examples.en: All passengers are required to show a ticket.
examples.cn: 所有乘客都被要求出示车票。

examples.en: The change will require more time than we expected.
examples.cn: 这项改动将需要比我们预期更多的时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: re-（再次）+ quire（寻求）＝不断寻求、必须有，即需要或要求；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次）+ quaerere（寻求）→ requirere（寻找、索取）→ 古法语 requerre → 中古英语 require。

sensesIntro.en: A need comes first, then a rule that turns the need into an obligation, then the consequence that makes an action necessary.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是需要，再是把需要变成义务的规则，最后是使某个行动成为必要的后果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a condition circled in red that must be met before anything proceeds.
core.cn: 核心意象：被红笔圈出的条件，不满足就无法继续。

branches.en: The plain need is the basic sense of the verb.
branches.cn: 朴素的需要，是动词的基本义项。

branches.en: A rule turns the need into an official demand.
branches.cn: 规则把需要变成正式要求。

branches.en: A consequence can make an action necessary.
branches.cn: 后果可以使某个行动成为必要。

branches.en: Need and demand both point to something that cannot be skipped.
branches.cn: 需要与要求都指向不可跳过之物。

branches.en: Rules and consequences both force the next step.
branches.cn: 规则与后果都强制下一步行动。

intro.en: Require is a Latin verb formed from a prefix and the seeking root quaerere.
intro.cn: require 是由前缀与「寻求」词根 quaerere 构成的拉丁动词。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, and quaerere means to seek, so requirere is to seek something out.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示再次，quaerere 表示寻求，所以 requirere 就是「把某物找出来」。

items.exampleCN: re- 出现在 require 与 request 开头。

items.example: Quaerere is the root of require.
items.exampleCN: quaerere 是 require 的词根。

items.example: Requirere is the Latin source of require.
items.exampleCN: requirere 是 require 的拉丁来源。
require 经法语进入英语。
requirement 在 require 后加 -ment。
requisite 共享拉丁词干。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ment 构成 requirement。
词尾 -ite 构成 requisite。

definition_en: something that is needed or officially demanded before something else can happen
core_image: 入学通知书背后列着一串必须满足的条件，逐条打钩才能注册
scene: 报名表背面列着语言成绩、体检证明等多项要求，缺一项就无法注册。The entrance requirement includes a health certificate.
sceneCN: 这里 requirement 是「要求；必要条件」（第 1 个义项：必须满足的条件）；句意：入学要求包括一份健康证明。

senses.title: Something that is needed
senses.definition: a thing that is necessary for something to happen or be achieved
senses.definitionCN: 某事发生或达成所必需的东西
senses.example: A good camera is a basic requirement for the course.
senses.exampleCN: 一台好相机是这门课程的基本要求。
senses.why: The noun names what the verb require points to: the need that must be met.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指 require 所指向的东西：必须被满足的需要。

senses.title: An official rule or demand
senses.definition: an official condition set by an authority
senses.definitionCN: 由权威机构设定的正式条件
senses.example: The building meets all safety requirements.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋建筑符合所有安全规定。
senses.why: When a need is written into a rule, it becomes a requirement in the official sense.
senses.whyCN: 当需要被写进规则，它就成为正式意义上的「要求」。

senses.title: The act of requiring
senses.definition: the act of demanding something formally
senses.definitionCN: 正式提出要求的动作
senses.example: The requirement of a deposit surprised the tenants.
senses.exampleCN: 要求交押金让租客们吃了一惊。
senses.why: The -ment ending can still name the action itself, not only its content.
senses.whyCN: -ment 词尾仍可指动作本身，而不只是动作的内容。

intro.en: Requirement is require plus the noun ending -ment, naming a needed condition or the act of demanding it.
intro.cn: requirement 是 require 加名词词尾 -ment，指必需的条件或提出要求的动作。

items.en: Quaerere means to seek, and requirere means to seek again.
items.cn: quaerere 意为寻求，requirere 意为再次寻求。

items.en: Old French requerre brings the demand sense into English require.
items.cn: 古法语 requerre 把「要求」义带进英语 require。

items.en: Middle English require covers need and obligation.
items.cn: 中古英语 require 涵盖需要与义务。

items.en: The noun requirement appears for a condition that must be met.
items.cn: 名词 requirement 出现，指必须满足的条件。

items.en: Education and engineering spread requirements in rules and specifications.
items.cn: 教育与工程使 requirements 广泛用于规则和规格说明。

items.en: Modern English uses it for entry rules, legal conditions, and design needs.
items.cn: 现代英语用它表示入学规则、法律条件和设计需求。

note.en: Requirement is the noun of require, and it is close to words for conditions that must be satisfied.
note.cn: requirement 是 require 的名词，与表示必须满足的条件的词相邻。

entries.definition: to need or demand
necessary for a purpose
an official demand for supplies
something that is needed
something that must be true before something else happens
something required before starting something
a detailed description of what is required

normalIntro.en: Requirement is require plus -ment, so it is the thing a need or rule requires you to have.
normalIntro.cn: requirement 是 require 加 -ment，指需要或规则要求你具备的东西。

normal.en: Require plus -ment: the condition that must be met.
normal.cn: require 加 -ment：必须被满足的条件。

normal.en: Meet the requirements is the phrase for satisfying every condition.
normal.cn: meet the requirements 意为满足所有条件。

normal.en: Entry requirements are what a school asks for before you can join.
normal.cn: entry requirements 是学校在你入学前提出的条件。

normal.en: A legal requirement is a condition written into law.
normal.cn: legal requirement 是写进法律的条件。

normal.en: The minimum requirement is the lowest condition still accepted.
normal.cn: minimum requirement 是仍被接受的最低条件。

abstract.en: Picture a checklist on the back of an admission letter, each box waiting for a tick.
abstract.cn: 想象入学通知书背面有一张清单，每个方框都等着打钩。

abstract.en: Imagine a doorway with a height bar that everyone must pass under.
abstract.cn: 想象门口有一根横杆，所有人都必须从下面通过。

abstract.en: Think of a recipe card listing what must be in the kitchen first.
abstract.cn: 想象一张食谱卡，先列出厨房里必须准备好的东西。

examples.en: The job has three basic requirements.
examples.cn: 这份工作有三项基本要求。

examples.en: All new buildings must meet fire safety requirements.
examples.cn: 所有新建筑都必须符合消防安全规定。

examples.en: Experience is a requirement for this position.
examples.cn: 经验是这个职位的必备条件。

dict_mnemonic.text: require（需要、要求）+ -ment（名词词尾）＝要求或必要条件；这是拆词联想，不是谐音。

root: require（需要、要求，源自拉丁语 requirere「再次寻求」）+ 名词词尾 -ment，指必须满足的条件或提出要求的行为。

sensesIntro.en: A needed thing comes first, then the official rule that demands it, then the act of demanding itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是必需之物，再是要求它的正式规则，最后是提出要求的行为本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a condition that must be ticked before the next step is allowed.
core.cn: 核心意象：必须打钩才能进入下一步的条件。

branches.en: The necessary thing is the basic sense of the noun.
branches.cn: 必需之物，是这个名词的基本义项。

branches.en: An official rule turns a need into a written condition.
branches.cn: 正式规则把需要变成书面条件。

branches.en: The noun can still name the act of demanding.
branches.cn: 这个名词仍可指提出要求的动作。

branches.en: Personal needs and official rules both set a bar to clear.
branches.cn: 个人需要与官方规则都设下一道必须跨过的门槛。

branches.en: The written rule and the act of demanding it are two sides of one condition.
branches.cn: 书面规则与提出要求的动作，是同一个条件的两面。

intro.en: Requirement is a transparent English noun: require plus the ending -ment.
intro.cn: requirement 是构词透明的英语名词：require 加词尾 -ment。

latinIntro.en: The base require comes from Latin requirere, to seek again, and -ment marks the action or its result.
latinIntro.cn: 基础词 require 来自拉丁语 requirere（再次寻求），-ment 标记动作或其结果。

items.example: Require is the base of requirement.
items.exampleCN: require 是 requirement 的基础词。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的名词词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ment 构成 requirement。
requirement 由 require 与 -ment 合成。
requirements 在 requirement 后加 -s。

items.example: Requisite shares the Latin seek root.
items.exampleCN: requisite 共享拉丁「寻求」词根。

items.example: Requisition shares the same Latin source.
items.exampleCN: requisition 共享同一拉丁来源。
re- 出现在 require 词干开头。

items.example: Quaerere is the deepest root of requirement.
items.exampleCN: quaerere 是 requirement 最深的词根。

definition_en: to save someone or something from danger or harm
core_image: 有人被水围住，救援者伸手把他拉上岸
scene: 洪水涨到窗台，消防员划着小船把一家人救了出来。When the flood reached the windows, firefighters rescued the family in a small boat.
sceneCN: 这里 rescue 是「营救」（第 1 个义项：把某人从危险中救出）；句意：洪水涨到窗台时，消防员用一条小船把一家人救了出来。

senses.title: To save from immediate danger
senses.definition: to get someone out of a dangerous place or situation
senses.definitionCN: 把某人从危险的地方或处境中救出来
senses.example: Firefighters rescued two people from the burning house.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员从燃烧的房子里救出两个人。
senses.why: The word begins with people in danger, so the core sense is physical saving.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从身处危险的人开始，所以核心义是身体上的救助。

senses.title: To save from a difficult situation
senses.definition: to help someone or something escape failure or embarrassment
senses.definitionCN: 帮助某人或某物脱离失败或尴尬
senses.example: A last-minute goal rescued the team from defeat.
senses.exampleCN: 最后时刻的一个进球把球队从失败中挽救回来。
senses.why: The same pulling-out image is applied to failure rather than physical danger.
senses.whyCN: 同样的「拉出来」意象，被用在失败而非身体危险上。

senses.title: An act of saving
senses.definition: the act of saving someone from danger, or an operation that does so
senses.definitionCN: 把某人从危险中救出的行为，或为此展开的行动
senses.example: The rescue took place at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 营救行动在黎明时展开。
senses.why: The verb is also used as a noun for the whole operation.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词也作名词，指整个营救行动。

intro.en: Rescue comes from Old French rescourre, to shake off or set free, from Latin excutere, to shake out.
intro.cn: rescue 来自古法语 rescourre（抖脱、使自由），源于拉丁语 excutere（抖出）。

items.en: Quatere means to shake.
items.cn: quatere 意为摇动。

items.en: Excutere means to shake out or drive off.
items.cn: excutere 意为抖出、赶走。

items.en: Escourre means to shake off or free oneself.
items.cn: escourre 意为抖脱、脱身。

items.en: Rescourre means to set free from danger.
items.cn: rescourre 意为从危险中解救。

items.en: Middle English rescuen keeps the sense of saving from harm.
items.cn: 中古英语 rescuen 保留「使免于伤害」的意思。

items.en: Modern English uses rescue for danger, failure, and emergency operations.
items.cn: 现代英语中，rescue 用于危险、失败与紧急行动。

note.en: Rescue is a pulling-out word, and it sits near its own family and near verbs for saving and freeing.
note.cn: rescue 是一个「拉出来」的词，与自身词族以及表示拯救和释放的动词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who saves others from danger
able to be saved
not yet saved
to keep someone safe from harm
to release someone from being trapped
to get something back after losing it

normalIntro.en: Rescue pictures a hand reaching into danger and pulling someone out.
normalIntro.cn: rescue 描绘一只手伸进危险，把人拉出来。

normal.en: The re- suggests pulling back, and the old root suggests shaking free.
normal.cn: re- 暗示往回拉，古老词根则暗示抖脱束缚。

normal.en: Rescue workers are the people who go in when others come out.
normal.cn: 救援人员就是别人往外跑时往里冲的人。

normal.en: Come to the rescue is a fixed phrase for offering help.
normal.cn: come to the rescue 是表示「前来帮忙」的固定短语。

normal.en: The noun and the verb look the same: a rescue, to rescue.
normal.cn: 名词和动词同形：a rescue 与 to rescue。

normal.en: Compare save: save is wider, while rescue usually means danger is present.
normal.cn: 对比 save：save 范围更广，rescue 通常意味着危险就在眼前。

abstract.en: Picture a rope thrown across dark water.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绳子被抛过漆黑的水面。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand gripping a wrist just before the current pulls.
abstract.cn: 想象在水流卷走前，一只手紧紧抓住手腕。

abstract.en: Think of a lighthouse beam finding a small boat.
abstract.cn: 想象灯塔的光束找到一条小船。

examples.en: Firefighters rescued two people from the burning house.
examples.cn: 消防员从燃烧的房子里救出两个人。

examples.en: A last-minute goal rescued the team from defeat.
examples.cn: 最后时刻的一个进球把球队从失败中挽救回来。

examples.en: The rescue took place at dawn.
examples.cn: 营救行动在黎明时展开。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「来救」——有危险时有人来救，就是 rescue；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 quatere（摇动）→ excutere（抖出）→ 古法语 escourre（抖脱）→ rescourre（解救）→ 中古英语 rescuen → 现代英语 rescue。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts with physical pulling out of danger, extends to rescue from failure, and also names the whole operation.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从把身体从危险中拉出开始，扩展到从失败中挽救，也可指整个营救行动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching into danger and pulling someone to safety.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手伸进危险，把人拉到安全处。

branches.en: Saving from physical danger is the core sense.
branches.cn: 从身体危险中救人，是核心义项。

branches.en: Saving from failure applies the pull to reputation or chances.
branches.cn: 从失败中挽救，把「拉」用于声誉或机会。

branches.en: The noun names the whole saving operation.
branches.cn: 名词指整个营救行动。

branches.en: Physical and figurative rescues both end in relief.
branches.cn: 身体与比喻意义上的营救都以松一口气结束。

branches.en: The act and the operation are described by the same word.
branches.cn: 救助行为与救援行动用同一个词描述。

intro.en: Rescue is a French verb built on a Latin root for shaking, with English endings forming its small family.
intro.cn: rescue 是建立在拉丁语「摇动」词根上的法语动词，小词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin quatere means to shake, and excutere means to shake out or drive off.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 quatere 意为摇动，excutere 意为抖出或赶走。

items.exampleCN: re- 增添「往回拉」的意思。
quatere 是深层词根。

items.example: Excutere gives the idea of shaking free.
items.exampleCN: excutere 提供「抖脱」的意思。

items.example: Escourre carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: escourre 把这个动词带入法语。

items.example: Rescourre is the direct source of rescue.
items.exampleCN: rescourre 是 rescue 的直接来源。
rescue 保留「救助」的含义。
rescuer 在动词后加 -er。
词尾 -er 构成 rescuer。
rescuable 在动词后加 -able。
词尾 -able 构成 rescuable。

definition_en: careful study to discover new facts or reach a better understanding
core_image: 一个人把旧资料摊满桌子，一遍遍查找线索
scene: 为了写这篇论文，她花了半年时间查阅地方档案。She spent six months in local archives to research the history of the town.
sceneCN: 这里 research 是「研究」（第 1 个义项：为发现事实而仔细查考）；句意：为了研究这座小镇的历史，她在地方档案馆待了半年。

senses.title: Systematic study of a subject
senses.definition: careful and organized study aimed at discovering facts
senses.definitionCN: 为发现事实而进行的细致、有条理的研究
senses.example: Recent research links sleep to memory.
senses.exampleCN: 最近的研究把睡眠与记忆联系起来。
senses.why: The noun names the whole activity of searching a subject again and again.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指对某个主题反复搜寻的整个活动。

senses.title: To study a subject carefully
senses.definition: to study something in detail in order to understand it
senses.definitionCN: 为理解某事物而详细研究
senses.example: She researched the history of the town for six months.
senses.exampleCN: 她研究这座小镇的历史研究了半年。
senses.why: The verb is the same repeated searching directed at a question.
senses.whyCN: 动词就是把同样的反复搜寻指向一个问题。

senses.title: Published findings
senses.definition: the results or body of work produced by study
senses.definitionCN: 研究产生的结果或成果集合
senses.example: His research on bees was published last year.
senses.exampleCN: 他关于蜜蜂的研究去年发表了。
senses.why: The activity is often named by its output, especially in academic writing.
senses.whyCN: 这项活动常以成果来指代，在学术写作中尤其如此。

intro.en: Research comes from Old French recerche, a search, from recercher, to seek out, built on re- and cerchier, to search.
intro.cn: research 来自古法语 recerche（搜寻），源于 recercher（找出），由 re- 与 cerchier（搜索）构成。

items.en: Circare means to go around or search through.
items.cn: circare 意为绕行、四处搜寻。

items.en: Cerchier means to search.
items.cn: cerchier 意为搜寻。

items.en: Recercher means to seek out thoroughly.
items.cn: recercher 意为彻底找出。

items.en: Recerche means a search or inquiry.
items.cn: recerche 意为搜寻、探究。

items.en: Middle English researchen means to investigate.
items.cn: 中古英语 researchen 意为调查、探究。

items.en: Modern English uses research for academic and scientific study.
items.cn: 现代英语中，research 用于学术与科学研究。

note.en: Research is a searching word, and it sits near its family and near words for study and inquiry.
note.cn: research 是一个「搜寻」词，与自身词族以及表示学习和探究的词相邻。

entries.definition: a person who does research
third person form of the verb
entries.definitionCN: 动词第三人称单数形式

entries.definition: past form of the verb
the activity of learning about a subject
a careful examination of facts
a question or formal investigation

normalIntro.en: Research is re- plus search: to search again and again until the answer appears.
normalIntro.cn: research 是 re- 加 search：一遍又一遍地搜寻，直到答案出现。

normal.en: Re- means again, and search means look for.
normal.cn: re- 表示再一次，search 表示寻找。

normal.en: Do research is the common phrase built on the noun.
normal.cn: do research 是由名词构成的常用短语。

normal.en: Research into a subject means looking closely at it.
normal.cn: research into a subject 意为仔细考察某个主题。

normal.en: A researcher is the person who does the searching.
normal.cn: researcher 就是做搜寻工作的人。

normal.en: Compare study: study can be quiet learning, while research aims at new facts.
normal.cn: 对比 study：study 可以是安静学习，research 则旨在发现新事实。

abstract.en: Picture a table covered with open books and marked pages.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上摊满打开的书和做了标记的纸页。

abstract.en: Imagine a scientist repeating a test to be sure.
abstract.cn: 想象科学家为求确定而重复一次实验。

abstract.en: Think of a single question followed through many files.
abstract.cn: 想象一个问题被追进一摞摞档案。

examples.en: She researched the history of the town for six months.
examples.cn: 她研究这座小镇的历史研究了半年。

examples.en: Recent research links sleep to memory.
examples.cn: 最近的研究把睡眠与记忆联系起来。

examples.en: The team is doing research into clean energy.
examples.cn: 团队正在研究清洁能源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + search」——一遍又一遍地搜寻，就是研究；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 circare（四处搜寻）→ 古法语 cerchier（搜索）→ recercher（找出）→ recerche（探究）→ 中古英语 researchen → 现代英语 research。

sensesIntro.en: The word is a repeated search: first the activity, then the verb of studying, then the published results of that study.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词就是「反复搜寻」：先指活动，再指研究的动词，最后指研究发表的成果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a question pursued through piles of evidence.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个问题被追过成堆的证据。

branches.en: Organized study is the main noun sense.
branches.cn: 有条理的研究，是主要名词义项。

branches.en: The verb names the act of searching a subject.
branches.cn: 动词指研究某个主题的行为。

branches.en: Published findings are the visible product of research.
branches.cn: 发表成果是研究可见的产物。

branches.en: The activity and the act are two views of one effort.
branches.cn: 活动与行为是同一种努力的两个视角。

branches.en: Searching produces findings, and findings invite more searching.
branches.cn: 搜寻产生成果，成果又引来更多搜寻。

intro.en: Research is a French-shaped word built on a Latin root for searching, with English endings forming its small family.
intro.cn: research 是建立在拉丁语「搜寻」词根上的法语形态词，小词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin circare means to go around or search, and French cerchier continues that sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circare 意为绕行、搜寻，法语 cerchier 延续这一含义。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of repeating.
items.exampleCN: re- 增添「反复」的意思。
circare 是深层词根。

items.example: Cerchier carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: cerchier 把这个动词带入法语。
recercher 加上「反复搜寻」。

items.example: Recerche is the direct source of research.
items.exampleCN: recerche 是 research 的直接来源。
research 保留「搜寻」的含义。
researcher 在动词后加 -er。
词尾 -er 构成 researcher。
researchable 在动词后加 -able。
词尾 -able 构成 researchable。

definition_zh: 研究者；科研人员；调查者；调研员；学术研究者
definition_en: a person whose job is to study a subject carefully in order to discover new facts or reach a judgement
core_image: 深夜的档案室里，一个人把三十年前的借阅卡一张张摊开，用铅笔在笔记本上画出时间线。
scene: 出版社编辑等这位作者交稿等了两年，因为他把每一份旧报纸都翻过一遍，才敢写下那一段历史。A careful researcher, he read every old newspaper before writing that chapter.
sceneCN: 这里 researcher 是“从事系统研究的人”（第 1 个义项）；句意：他靠反复查证原始材料来完成研究。

pos.zh: 研究者；科研人员；调查者

senses.title: Someone who studies systematically
senses.titleCN: 研究者：系统地查证一个问题的人
senses.definition: a person who investigates a subject in a planned, systematic way
senses.definitionCN: 以有计划、系统的方式探究某个主题的人
senses.example: The researcher spent four years tracking the same herd.
senses.exampleCN: 这位研究者花了四年追踪同一群动物。
senses.why: The agent suffix -er marks the person who performs the action named by research, and research literally means searching again and again.
senses.whyCN: 施事后缀 -er 标记执行 research 这一动作的人，而 research 字面上就是“反复搜寻”。

senses.title: An investigator of facts
senses.titleCN: 调查者：把事实一层层挖出来的人
senses.definition: a person who digs out facts, especially for a report or an inquiry
senses.definitionCN: 把事实层层挖出的人，尤指为报道或调查
senses.example: The researcher found the missing invoice in a county archive.
senses.exampleCN: 这位调查者在县档案馆找到了那张失踪的发票。
senses.why: Research began as intensive searching, so the person sense covers reporters and investigators, not only scientists.
senses.whyCN: research 本义是密集搜寻，因此这个指人的义项也覆盖记者与调查员，而不只是科学家。

senses.title: A member of a lab or university
senses.titleCN: 科研人员：实验室与大学里的研究者
senses.definition: a scientist or scholar employed to carry out academic or laboratory research
senses.definitionCN: 受雇从事学术或实验室研究的科学家或学者
senses.example: Two researchers in the lab share the microscopy work.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室里的两名科研人员分担显微观察工作。
senses.why: Institutions turn the activity into a post, and the post gives the word its most common occupational sense.
senses.whyCN: 机构把这项活动变成岗位，而岗位赋予这个词最常见的职业含义。

senses.title: A clinical investigator
senses.titleCN: 临床研究员：在病人身上验证疗法的人
senses.definition: someone who runs or assists medical studies with human participants
senses.definitionCN: 主持或协助以人为对象的医学研究的人
senses.example: The clinical researcher explained the trial to each volunteer.
senses.exampleCN: 临床研究员向每位志愿者解释了试验内容。
senses.why: When the field is medicine, the search is for safety and effect in people, so the same title carries ethical duties.
senses.whyCN: 当领域是医学时，所搜寻的是药物在人身上的安全与效果，因此同一头衔也带着伦理责任。

senses.title: A market or survey analyst
senses.titleCN: 调研员：用问卷和数据摸清市场的人
senses.definition: a person who designs surveys or studies consumers for a company
senses.definitionCN: 为公司设计问卷或研究消费者的人
senses.example: The market researcher ran focus groups before the launch.
senses.exampleCN: 市场调研员在产品发布前组织了焦点小组。
senses.why: Commercial research also searches, but its object is preference and demand rather than natural law.
senses.whyCN: 商业研究同样在搜寻，但对象是偏好与需求，而不是自然规律。

senses.title: Someone working outside institutions
senses.titleCN: 独立研究者：不隶属机构的学者
senses.definition: a scholar who pursues research without a university or company post
senses.definitionCN: 不在大学或公司任职而从事研究的学者
senses.example: An independent researcher corrected the census transcription.
senses.exampleCN: 一位独立研究者更正了那次人口普查的转录。
senses.why: The word names the activity, not the employer; removing the institution leaves the searching intact.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名的是活动而非雇主；去掉机构，搜寻这件事依然完整。

senses.title: A digger in archives
senses.titleCN: 史料研究者：在档案堆里找证据的人
senses.definition: a person whose method is the close reading of documents, records, and manuscripts
senses.definitionCN: 以细读文件、记录与手稿为方法的人
senses.example: The historian works as a researcher in the national library.
senses.exampleCN: 这位历史学家在国家图书馆做史料研究。
senses.why: Documents are a second kind of field: evidence is buried in paper, and finding it is still a search.
senses.whyCN: 文献是另一种田野：证据埋在纸堆里，把它找出来仍然是搜寻。

senses.title: A student learning the craft
senses.titleCN: 研究生研究者：边学边做的年轻学者
senses.definition: a graduate student or junior member learning to conduct research within a team
senses.definitionCN: 在团队中边学习边开展研究的研究生或初级成员
senses.example: Each researcher presents her findings at the weekly seminar.
senses.exampleCN: 每位研究生研究者都在每周讨论会上报告自己的发现。
senses.why: Training and research merge in the modern laboratory, so the title also covers those still learning the method.
senses.whyCN: 现代实验室里训练与研究合而为一，因此这个头衔也覆盖仍在学习方法的人。

intro.en: Researcher is research plus -er. Research is re- plus search, and search goes back through Old French cerchier to Latin circare, to go about, from circus, a circle.
intro.cn: researcher 由 research 加 -er 构成。research 是 re- 加 search，而 search 经古法语 cerchier 上溯到拉丁语 circare“四处走动”，其词源为 circus“圆圈”。

items.en: Circus meant a ring or circle. The round track supplied the image of going round and round a space.
items.cn: circus 意为“圆圈、环”。环形跑道提供了“绕着某处来回走”的形象。

items.en: Circare meant to go about or wander over an area. Searching is pictured as walking a territory until nothing is missed.
items.cn: circare 意为在某区域内走动、巡行。搜寻被想象成把一片地方走遍，直到没有遗漏。

items.en: Old French cerchier meant to search or seek, keeping the image of circling a place to find something.
items.cn: 古法语 cerchier 意为搜寻、寻找，保留了“绕着某处转以找到东西”的形象。

items.en: Middle French recerche meant a close search, with re- adding intensity or repetition rather than simple return.
items.cn: 中古法语 recerche 意为仔细搜寻，其中的 re- 加强的是强度或反复，而不只是“返回”。

items.en: English research first meant the act of searching closely; only later did it become the systematic study of a subject.
items.cn: 英语 research 最初指仔细搜寻的行为，后来才指对某一主题的系统研究。

items.en: The Old English agent suffix -ere became -er, marking the person who performs the action of the verb.
items.cn: 古英语施事后缀 -ere 演变为 -er，标记执行动词动作的人。

note.en: The first group is the research family, separated by word class; the second compares people who investigate in different settings.
note.cn: 第一组是 research 词族，按词类区分；第二组比较在不同场景中从事调查的人。

entries.definition: systematic investigation of a subject. It names the activity or the body of work.
entries.definitionCN: 对某主题的系统研究；命名的是活动或成果。

entries.definition: able to be investigated with available methods and evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 能够用现有方法与证据加以研究的。

entries.definition: carefully investigated, as in a well-researched article. It judges the finished product.
entries.definitionCN: 经过仔细研究的，如“研究扎实的文章”；评判的是成品。

entries.definition: a person who investigates, especially a crime or an official inquiry. It stresses uncovering causes.
entries.definitionCN: 从事调查的人，尤指刑事案件或官方调查；强调查明原因。

entries.definition: a person with deep learning in a field. It stresses knowledge rather than the process of discovery.
entries.definitionCN: 在某一领域学识深厚的人；强调学识而非发现过程。

entries.definition: a person who examines data or situations to explain them. It stresses interpretation.
entries.definitionCN: 分析数据或形势以作出解释的人；强调解读。

entries.definition: a person trained in a natural or social science. It names a profession rather than an activity.
entries.definitionCN: 受过自然科学或社会科学训练的人；命名的是职业而非活动。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: re-, search, -er. Search itself comes from a Latin verb for going round a place, so a researcher is someone who keeps walking the territory.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：re-、search、-er。search 出自拉丁语中“绕行某地”的动词，因此研究者就是反复走遍这片地方的人。

normal.en: Re plus search plus er: the person who searches again and again.
normal.cn: re 加 search 加 er：一遍又一遍搜寻的那个人。

normal.en: Search comes from circling a field until nothing is missed.
normal.cn: search 出自绕着田野走遍、直到没有遗漏。

normal.en: A researcher in an archive is walking a paper field.
normal.cn: 在档案馆里的研究者，是在一片纸做的田野上行走。

normal.en: The -er tells you who; the research tells you what they keep doing.
normal.cn: 词尾告诉你“谁”，词根告诉你“他一直在做什么”。

normal.en: A clinical researcher searches for safety in people, not in test tubes.
normal.cn: 临床研究员在人身上寻找安全性，而不是在试管里。

abstract.en: Research is only called systematic when the searcher can say where the search stopped.
abstract.cn: 只有当搜寻者说得出自己在哪里停下时，研究才被称为系统的。

abstract.en: Every researcher chooses a small field to walk, and the choice is already an argument.
abstract.cn: 每位研究者都选一小片田野去走，而这个选择本身已是一种主张。

abstract.en: The word keeps its old image: knowledge is produced by circling a question long enough.
abstract.cn: 这个词保留着旧形象：知识是靠围绕一个问题转得足够久才产生的。

examples.en: Researchers at three universities compared the same soil samples.
examples.cn: 三所大学的研究者比较了同一批土壤样本。

examples.en: As a researcher, she is known for checking every citation by hand.
examples.cn: 作为研究者，她以逐条手工核对引文而闻名。

examples.en: The market researcher found that shoppers ignored the new labels.
examples.cn: 市场调研员发现购物者根本不看新标签。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（反复）+ search（搜寻）+ er（人）——反复搜寻的人，就是研究者。

root: 由 research（研究、反复搜寻）加 -er（施事者后缀）构成；research 为 re-（反复、加强）加 search（搜寻，经古法语 cerchier 源自拉丁语 circare“巡行、绕行”，词源为 circus“圆圈”），本义为“反复走访以查明问题的人”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of researcher, all circling one idea: a person who searches a subject until the evidence settles. The search may be academic, journalistic, clinical, commercial, independent, archival, or still being learned.
sensesIntro.cn: researcher 的八个义项都围绕一个观念：把一个问题搜寻到证据落定为止的人。这种搜寻可以是学术的、新闻的、临床的、商业的、独立的、档案的，也可以是尚在学习中的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a document room at midnight, thirty-year-old borrowing cards spread out, a timeline drawn in pencil.
core.cn: 核心意象：午夜的档案室，三十年前的借阅卡摊满桌面，铅笔画出时间线。

branches.en: THE SEARCH ITSELF: systematic inquiry, and the digging out of facts for a report or inquiry.
branches.cn: 搜寻本身：系统探究，以及为报道或调查把事实挖出来。

branches.en: INSTITUTIONAL ROLES: a laboratory or university post, and a clinical investigator with ethical duties.
branches.cn: 机构角色：实验室或大学岗位，以及承担伦理责任的临床研究员。

branches.en: COMMERCIAL SEARCH: surveys and consumer studies aimed at demand rather than natural law.
branches.cn: 商业搜寻：面向需求而非自然规律的问卷与消费者研究。

branches.en: OUTSIDE AND INSIDE THE ARCHIVE: the independent scholar and the close reader of documents.
branches.cn: 档案内外：独立学者，与细读文献的人。

branches.en: THE CRAFT BEING LEARNED: a junior member who researches while still in training.
branches.cn: 正在学习的技艺：一边受训一边做研究的初级成员。

intro.en: Researcher is research plus -er. Research is re- plus search, and the -er suffix marks the person. The family also supplies researchable and researched.
intro.cn: researcher 由 research 加 -er 构成。research 是 re- 加 search，-er 标记人。词族还包括 researchable 与 researched。

latinIntro.en: Latin circus and circare supply the base of search through Old French. The prefix re- is Latin, and the agent suffix -er is native English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 circus 与 circare 经古法语提供了 search 的词基。前缀 re- 来自拉丁语，施事后缀 -er 是英语本族成分。

items.example: The Latin word survives in English circus and in circle.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁词在英语 circus（马戏场）与 circle（圆圈）中留存。

items.example: The verb described going over a district in search of something.
items.exampleCN: 该动词描述为寻找某物而走遍一个区域。

items.example: They searched the attic for the missing deed.
items.exampleCN: 他们在阁楼里寻找那份失踪的地契。

items.meaningCN: 仔细搜寻，后指系统研究
items.example: Her research on the harbour took ten years.
items.exampleCN: 她对这座港口的研究花了十年。

items.meaning: a person who carries out research
items.example: A researcher must record where each figure came from.
items.exampleCN: 研究者必须记录每个数据的来源。

items.meaning: more than one person carrying out research
items.example: Researchers disagree about the date of the wall.
items.exampleCN: 研究者们对这段城墙的年代意见不一。

items.meaning: able to be investigated with available evidence
items.meaningCN: 可研究的；有证据可查的
items.example: The question is interesting but barely researchable.
items.exampleCN: 这个问题很有意思，却几乎无法研究。

items.example: The biography is well researched and clearly written.
items.exampleCN: 这部传记研究扎实，文字清晰。

items.example: The school adopted a research-based reading programme.
items.exampleCN: 学校采用了一套基于研究的阅读课程。

definition_en: to look or seem like someone or something else
core_image: 两个人站在一起，侧脸轮廓几乎重叠
scene: 这对双胞胎长得太像，连老师都会认错。The twins resemble each other so closely that even their teacher mixes them up.
sceneCN: 这里 resemble 是「像」（第 1 个义项：在外貌或性质上相似）；句意：这对双胞胎长得太像，连老师都会认错。

senses.title: To look like someone
senses.definition: to have a similar appearance to another person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 外貌与另一个人或物相似
senses.example: She closely resembles her mother.
senses.exampleCN: 她长得很像她母亲。
senses.why: The Latin root means like, so the verb starts with visible likeness.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词根意为「像」，所以这个动词从看得见的外貌相似开始。

senses.title: To have similar qualities
senses.definition: to share features or qualities with something else
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物共享特征或性质
senses.example: Their styles resemble each other in many ways.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的风格在许多方面彼此相似。
senses.why: Likeness moves from faces to abstract patterns and styles.
senses.whyCN: 相似从面容扩展到抽象的模式与风格。

senses.title: To seem like something
senses.definition: to give the impression of being something, often in formal description
senses.definitionCN: 给人某种印象，常用于正式描写
senses.example: The room resembled a small museum.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间看起来像一座小博物馆。
senses.why: The verb can describe an overall impression, not only a physical match.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词可描述整体印象，而不只是外形吻合。

intro.en: Resemble comes from Old French resembler, from re- and sembler, to seem, ultimately from Latin similis, like.
intro.cn: resemble 来自古法语 resembler，由 re- 与 sembler（显得）构成，最终源于拉丁语 similis（像）。

items.en: Similis means like or similar.
items.cn: similis 意为相像、相似。

items.en: Similare means to make like.
items.cn: similare 意为使相像。

items.en: Sembler means to seem or appear.
items.cn: sembler 意为显得、看起来。

items.en: Resembler means to be like or resemble.
items.cn: resembler 意为相像、类似。

items.en: Middle English resemblen keeps the visual sense.
items.cn: 中古英语 resemblen 保留视觉上的相似。

items.en: Modern English extends resemble to styles, sounds, and situations.
items.cn: 现代英语把 resemble 扩展到风格、声音与情境。

note.en: Resemble is a likeness verb, and it sits near its family and near phrases for looking like.
note.cn: resemble 是一个「相似」动词，与自身词族以及表示「像」的短语相邻。

entries.definition: the state of being similar
similar to something
to bring people or parts together
to have a similar appearance
to look or behave like an older relative
to reflect or match something closely

normalIntro.en: Resemble contains the old root similis, like: to resemble is to be like.
normalIntro.cn: resemble 含有古老词根 similis（像）：相像就是「像」。

normal.en: The re- adds the sense of looking back and seeing the same shape.
normal.cn: re- 增添「回头一看还是同一个轮廓」的感觉。

normal.en: Resemble each other is the most common phrase.
normal.cn: resemble each other 是最常见的短语。

normal.en: Resemblance is the noun for the likeness.
normal.cn: resemblance 是表示「相似」的名词。

normal.en: We resemble family members in looks or manner.
normal.cn: 我们在外貌或举止上像家人。

normal.en: Compare look like: resemble is more formal and uses a single verb.
normal.cn: 对比 look like：resemble 更正式，而且只用一个动词。

abstract.en: Picture two shadows falling at the same angle.
abstract.cn: 想象两道影子以同样的角度落下。

abstract.en: Imagine a face in a photograph echoing another face.
abstract.cn: 想象照片中的一张脸与另一张脸遥相呼应。

abstract.en: Think of two melodies that share the same opening notes.
abstract.cn: 想象两段旋律以相同的开头几个音起句。

examples.en: She closely resembles her mother.
examples.cn: 她长得很像她母亲。

examples.en: Their styles resemble each other in many ways.
examples.cn: 他们的风格在许多方面彼此相似。

examples.en: The room resembled a small museum.
examples.cn: 这个房间看起来像一座小博物馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + semble」——一再看到同样的样子，就是相像；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 similis（像）→ 俗拉丁语 similare（使相像）→ 古法语 sembler（显得）→ resembler（相像）→ 中古英语 resemblen → 现代英语 resemble。

sensesIntro.en: The verb begins with faces, extends to qualities and styles, and finally to the overall impression something gives.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词从面容开始，扩展到性质与风格，最后指某物给人的整体印象。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two outlines laid over each other until they nearly match.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个轮廓叠在一起，几乎重合。

branches.en: Physical likeness is the oldest and clearest sense.
branches.cn: 外貌相似，是最古老、最清楚的义项。

branches.en: Shared qualities extend likeness beyond appearance.
branches.cn: 共同性质把相似扩展到外貌之外。

branches.en: An overall impression can resemble something else.
branches.cn: 整体印象也可以像另一事物。

branches.en: People can look alike and behave alike at once.
branches.cn: 人可以同时长得像、举止也像。

branches.en: Shared qualities often create the impression of a match.
branches.cn: 共同性质常造成「相互吻合」的印象。

intro.en: Resemble is a French verb built on the Latin root for like, with English endings forming its family.
intro.cn: resemble 是建立在拉丁语「像」词根上的法语动词，词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin similis means like, and similare means to make like; French sembler means to seem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 similis 意为像，similare 意为使相像；法语 sembler 意为显得。

items.example: Re- adds the sense of repeated likeness.
items.exampleCN: re- 增添「反复相似」的意思。
similis 是深层词根。

items.example: Similare turns the adjective into a verb.
items.exampleCN: similare 把形容词变成动词。

items.example: Sembler carries the root into French.
items.exampleCN: sembler 把词根带入法语。
resembler 是直接来源。
resemble 保留「相似」的含义。
resemblance 在动词后加 -ance。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或性质的词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ance 构成 resemblance。
resembling 在动词后加 -ing。
词尾 -ing 构成 resembling。

definition_en: an arrangement to keep a seat or room, or a doubt held back
core_image: 桌上放着一张小牌子：此位已留
scene: 她提前一周订了靠窗的位子，准备给母亲过生日。She made a reservation for a window table a week in advance for her mother's birthday.
sceneCN: 这里 reservation 是「预订」（第 1 个义项：预先保留座位或房间）；句意：她提前一周订了靠窗的位子，准备给母亲过生日。

senses.title: An arrangement to keep a place
senses.definition: an arrangement by which a seat, room, or table is kept for you
senses.definitionCN: 为你保留座位、房间或餐桌的安排
senses.example: I made a reservation for two at seven.
senses.exampleCN: 我订了七点两个人的位子。
senses.why: The noun names the result of reserving something in advance.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词指预先保留某物的结果。

senses.title: Land kept for a purpose
senses.definition: an area of land kept for a particular use, such as wildlife
senses.definitionCN: 为特定用途保留的一片土地，如野生动物保护
senses.example: The lake lies inside a wildlife reservation.
senses.exampleCN: 这个湖位于一片野生动物保护区内。
senses.why: Keeping something back applies to land as well as to seats.
senses.whyCN: 「保留下来」既适用于座位，也适用于土地。

senses.title: A doubt held back
senses.definition: a doubt or condition that stops you from fully agreeing
senses.definitionCN: 使你无法完全同意的疑虑或条件
senses.example: She agreed to the plan without reservation.
senses.exampleCN: 她毫无保留地同意了这个计划。
senses.why: A reservation is something kept back in the mind rather than spoken at once.
senses.whyCN: 保留意见是留在心里、没有立刻说出的东西。

intro.en: Reservation comes from Latin reservare, to keep back, from re- and servare, to keep.
intro.cn: reservation 来自拉丁语 reservare（保留），由 re- 与 servare（保存）构成。

items.en: Servare means to keep or preserve.
items.cn: servare 意为保存、保全。

items.en: Reservare means to keep back for later.
items.cn: reservare 意为留到以后。

items.en: Reserver means to reserve or hold back.
items.cn: reserver 意为保留、扣下。

items.en: Middle English reserven means to keep something back.
items.cn: 中古英语 reserven 意为把某物留下。

items.en: Reservation appears as a noun for something kept back.
items.cn: 到 14 世纪，reservation 作为名词出现，指被保留之物。

items.en: Modern English adds the senses of booking and protected land.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「预订」与「保留地」两个义项。

note.en: Reservation is the -ation noun of reserve, and it sits near its family and near words for booking and doubt.
note.cn: reservation 是 reserve 的 -ation 名词，与自身词族以及表示预订和疑虑的词相邻。

entries.definition: to keep something for later
kept for later, or quiet and restrained
a member of a military reserve force
an arrangement made in advance
a feeling of not being sure
a condition added to a statement

normalIntro.en: Reservation is reserve plus -ation, so it names the act of keeping something back.
normalIntro.cn: reservation 是 reserve 加 -ation，指把某物保留下来的行为。

normal.en: A table reservation keeps a place for you.
normal.cn: table reservation 为你留住一个位子。

normal.en: Without reservation means with no doubt held back.
normal.cn: without reservation 意为毫无保留。

normal.en: The same noun can mean a protected area kept for a purpose.
normal.cn: 同一个名词也可指为特定目的保留的区域。

normal.en: Reserve is the verb, and reservation is the arrangement.
normal.cn: reserve 是动词，reservation 是安排。

normal.en: Compare booking: booking is the everyday word, while reservation is more formal.
normal.cn: 对比 booking：booking 更日常，reservation 更正式。

abstract.en: Picture a small card on a table saying the seat is held.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上放着一张小卡片，写着位子已留。

abstract.en: Imagine a hand hovering over a question rather than agreeing at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手悬在问题上，没有立刻答应。

abstract.en: Think of a fenced field set aside for animals.
abstract.cn: 想象一片围起来的田地，专门留给动物。

examples.en: I made a reservation for two at seven.
examples.cn: 我订了七点两个人的位子。

examples.en: She agreed to the plan without reservation.
examples.cn: 她毫无保留地同意了这个计划。

examples.en: The hotel lost our reservation.
examples.cn: 酒店把我们的预订弄丢了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + serve」——预先保留下来为客人服务，就是预订；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 servare（保存）→ reservare（保留）→ 古法语 reserver → 中古英语 reserven → reserve ＋ -ation → reservation。

sensesIntro.en: The noun starts as something kept back, then names a booked place, a protected area, and finally a doubt kept back in the mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个名词从「被保留之物」开始，进而指预订的位子、受保护的区域，最后指留在心里的疑虑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a place or thing marked as held for someone.
core.cn: 核心意象：某处或某物被标记为「已为某人留住」。

branches.en: A booking is the everyday modern sense.
branches.cn: 预订，是现代日常义项。

branches.en: Protected land is something kept back for a purpose.
branches.cn: 保护区是为特定目的保留的土地。

branches.en: A doubt is something kept back from full agreement.
branches.cn: 保留意见是从完全同意中收回的部分。

branches.en: A seat and a field are both held for future use.
branches.cn: 座位与土地都是留作以后使用。

branches.en: Booking a place and withholding judgment both involve holding back.
branches.cn: 预订位子与保留判断都涉及「留住」。

intro.en: Reservation is an English -ation noun built on the Latin verb reservare.
intro.cn: reservation 是建立在拉丁动词 reservare 上的英语 -ation 名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin servare means to keep, and reservare means to keep back; French reserver carries the verb onward.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 servare 意为保存，reservare 意为保留；法语 reserver 把这个动词继续传递。

items.example: Re- adds the idea of keeping back.
items.exampleCN: re- 增添「留在后面」的意思。
servare 是深层词根。

items.example: Reservare joins the prefix and the root.
items.exampleCN: reservare 把前缀与词根结合。

items.example: Reserver carries the verb into French.
items.exampleCN: reserver 把这个动词带入法语。
reserve 是基础词。
reservation 在 reserve 后加 -ation。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作或结果的词尾
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ation 构成 reservation。
reserved 在 reserve 后加 -ed。
词尾 -ed 构成 reserved。
reservist 在 reserve 后加 -ist。

definition_en: to keep something for future use, or a supply kept in readiness
core_image: 仓库深处留着一批物资，标签上写着「备用」
scene: 他们在车库后面留了几箱水，以备停电时使用。They reserved several boxes of water behind the garage in case the power failed.
sceneCN: 这里 reserve 是「保留」（第 1 个义项：留作以后使用）；句意：他们在车库后面留了几箱水，以备停电时使用。

senses.title: To keep for future use
senses.definition: to keep something so that it can be used later
senses.definitionCN: 把某物留存下来，供以后使用
senses.example: They reserved several boxes of water behind the garage.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在车库后面留了几箱水。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to keep back, which is the core of every sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为保留，这是所有义项的核心。

senses.title: A supply kept ready
senses.definition: an amount of something kept for use in an emergency or later
senses.definitionCN: 为紧急情况或以后使用而储存的数量
senses.example: The army kept a reserve of fuel.
senses.exampleCN: 军队储备了燃料。
senses.why: The noun names the thing that has been kept back.
senses.whyCN: 名词指被保留下来的东西。

senses.title: Self-restraint
senses.definition: the habit of not showing feelings or thoughts openly
senses.definitionCN: 不轻易外露情感或想法的习惯
senses.example: He spoke with reserve about his own success.
senses.exampleCN: 他谈到自己的成功时很克制。
senses.why: Feelings kept back from view produce the social sense of reserve.
senses.whyCN: 情感被留在视线之外，就产生「矜持」这一社交含义。

intro.en: Reserve comes from Latin reservare, to keep back, from re- and servare, to keep, through Old French reserver.
intro.cn: reserve 来自拉丁语 reservare（保留），由 re- 与 servare（保存）构成，经古法语 reserver 进入英语。

items.en: Servare means to keep or preserve.
items.cn: servare 意为保存、保全。

items.en: Reservare means to keep back for later.
items.cn: reservare 意为留到以后。

items.en: Reserver means to reserve or hold back.
items.cn: reserver 意为保留、扣下。

items.en: Middle English reserven means to keep back.
items.cn: 中古英语 reserven 意为保留。

items.en: Reserve appears as a noun for a supply kept ready.
items.cn: 到 16 世纪，reserve 作为名词出现，指备用的储备。

items.en: Modern English adds the sense of personal restraint.
items.cn: 现代英语增加了「个人克制」这一义项。

note.en: Reserve is a keeping-back word, and it sits near its family and near verbs for keeping and booking.
note.cn: reserve 是一个「留住」词，与自身词族以及表示保存和预订的动词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Reserve is re- plus the Latin root for keep: to keep something back for later.
normalIntro.cn: reserve 是 re- 加拉丁语「保存」词根：把东西留到以后。

normal.en: Reserve a table means keep it for a future time.
normal.cn: reserve a table 意为把桌子留到以后用。

normal.en: A nature reserve is land kept for wildlife.
normal.cn: nature reserve 是为野生动物保留的土地。

normal.en: In reserve means held ready but not yet used.
normal.cn: in reserve 意为留作备用、尚未使用。

normal.en: Reserved can describe a quiet, restrained person.
normal.cn: reserved 可以形容安静、克制的人。

normal.en: Compare keep: keep is general, while reserve stresses setting aside.
normal.cn: 对比 keep：keep 更泛，reserve 强调「单独留出来」。

abstract.en: Picture boxes stacked at the back of a garage.
abstract.cn: 想象车库深处堆着几只箱子。

abstract.en: Imagine a fuel gauge with a hidden lower section.
abstract.cn: 想象油表下面还藏着一段备用油量。

abstract.en: Think of a quiet person holding words back.
abstract.cn: 想象一个安静的人把话留在心里。

examples.en: Please reserve a table for two.
examples.cn: 请订一张两人桌。

examples.en: They reserved several boxes of water behind the garage.
examples.cn: 他们在车库后面留了几箱水。

examples.en: The nature reserve protects rare birds.
examples.cn: 自然保护区保护稀有鸟类。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「re + serve」——留下来以后再用，就是保留；这只是构词联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 servare（保存）→ reservare（保留）→ 古法语 reserver → 中古英语 reserven → 现代英语 reserve，核心义「留住备用」。

sensesIntro.en: The word keeps one image, holding something back: a thing kept for later, a supply set aside, and feelings kept out of sight.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词始终保留一个意象——把东西留住：留待以后之物、单列出来的储备，以及不外露的情感。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a supply set aside with a label saying for later.
core.cn: 核心意象：一批物资被单独放好，标签写着「留待以后」。

branches.en: Keeping something for later is the core verb sense.
branches.cn: 留作后用，是核心动词义项。

branches.en: A reserve is the supply that has been set aside.
branches.cn: 储备就是被单独留出的物资。

branches.en: Reserve of manner is feeling kept back from view.
branches.cn: 举止上的矜持，是情感被留在视线之外。

branches.en: The act of reserving creates the thing held in reserve.
branches.cn: 保留的行为造出了储备之物。

branches.en: A hidden supply and hidden feeling share the same restraint.
branches.cn: 隐藏的物资与隐藏的情感共享同一种克制。

intro.en: Reserve is a Latin verb reshaped by French, and English endings form its modern family.
intro.cn: reserve 是经法语改造的拉丁动词，现代词族由英语词尾构成。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 servare 意为保存，reservare 意为保留。
